comments: I just loved my stay here- the view from my room was amazing, it captured some of Melbournes great high rise buildings and looked stunning all lit up in the evening. The staff were so helpful and accomodating. It was very clean, very easy to find and I felt like I had everything I need, right there. I will definitely be coming back again. Thank you so much 😊

Carolyn’s place was the perfect place to stay with a dog who was over for medical things. It was flat and the grass park opposite was excellent for short walks for my dog. The house was well stocked and very comfortable. The location was private and quiet. The shower was amazing and washing facilities and provisions were excellent. Carolyn was very helpful and we loved our stay! Thank you!

Awesome place to stay, great location & will definitely be back 2 stay again!!
Vincent was very accommodating & excellent 2 deal with. 🙏
Comfortable apartment with awesome views, has everything you need in a handy location. Hosts where very helpful & quick with communication & directions, would definitely stay again.

Anthony's place was a great place to stay. Very funky vibe, easy tramride into town, the local shops were varied & accessible. The neighbourhood is very cool. Over the road is a cycleway that runs around the city so the bikes are a great idea. The place was quiet & had everything we may have needed & more. Anthony was a great host. Very much recommended.

Maha was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to our needs/requests. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful.  The property is absolutely clean and stylish.
It is exactly the same as shown in the pictures. We could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place; we would stay here again easily! We were delighted to find such a modern and clean space right near where we wanted to be.
It was the perfect place for us to stay and such a great value. Thank you so much Maha.

The host is very responsive
The view is amazing , especially in the master bedroom and living room
Thanks CMB for hosting us
I had wonderful experience when staying here. Good location, well equipped house, everything is super clean and convenient. Alex is great host, quick response when I need help. Highly recommend!
Fantastic place. I would definitely recommend. Libby and Rob are very thoughtful.  The beds are very comfortable and the blankets cozy. The baked goodies were a welcome treat.

We just loved our stay at Enda cottage. It is a gorgeous, stylish place and set up for a very comfortable stay for the 8 of us. There was a bowl of chocolates waiting for us on arrival, and fruit/breakfast supplies provided. There is also a piano, and we had a fun sing a long session on the Saturday evening. It was the perfect location from which to begin and end our yarra valley winery tour by bike. Thanks Vikki, we would definitely come back!

Had a great time.
Easy to find and check-in and so close to Brunswick St without the noise.
Would visit again!

Location superb, plenty of space and all the amenities one could ask for!
Katie is responsive and very helpful. Was sad to be leaving and would definitely return.

If you're booking solo or couple, this apartment is perfect for you as it was for me. This place is spacious enough to feel comfortable. The photo's are accurate especially the beautiful outside view which also looks spectacular during night. The apartment is right across from Woolworths which is good for daily essentials. It's also close to the CBD, The Crown, Railway Station, and Trams - all are 5 to 10 minutes of walk.
Zhixin is a great host that responds asap and is happy to assist in any way!
I would definitely book this place again and recommend it towards others specifically solo or couples.

Beautiful property. We are so glad he offered us this outstanding option. Very spacious, good view, walkable, close to anywhere, very convenient, clean and tidy. It was the hardest goodbye :’)
They are highly recommended hosts. Very responsive in communication. Will definitely come back here.

that area has really nice restaurants and good mart. and very close to tram.
the place itself was nice, clean and beautiful. and they have every appliances we needed.
I definitely want to book here again when I come back to Melbourne.
100% recommend!

Staff were all very friendly and checked us in and out with ease. Parking is a shorter walk than it seems and there’s a good coffee shop on the way. Apartment was clean and had a really good view of the yarra river and buildings. Would stay here again

Thanks so much for a wonderful stay in your beautiful home 🤍 you guys were just so warm and welcoming. The space is clean and so well equipped. Simon even offered me a lift to my work place down the road so I wouldn’t have to walk! Just the best airbnb experience, thank you guys!

Jun was an absolute fantastic host.
we needed an early check in and a baby high chair and Jun was very responsive and flexible with everything.
The apartment was good with everything as seen in the photos and shower was great (constant hot water). the beds had a variety of pillows to choose from and bed was comfy as well.
having a little one it's great to know that there's a park with a decent playground within walking distance to let them run around and play.
Great food places are also nearby (recommend Paik's Bibim)
would stay again!

Convenient location, tram outside door, size was fine for the three of us wanting three separate bedrooms, had everything we needed except... we all had uncomfortable beds the first thing we wanted was  comfortable beds so we could get a good sleep and feel refreshed in the morning ...front bedroom is noisey which is to be expected so take airplugs.  No lock on bathroom/toilet which can lead to embarrassing moments. We chose this place because of mainly good reviews however when we were staying there we went back through the reviews and did notice that many of the reviews were for the other unit. We suggest replacing with good quality comfortable mattresses. Wifi code written down somewhere would have been good on our arrival I had to get roaming to access the online listing instructions to get the wifi code.

Beautiful little apartment in such a good location. Melissa was more then helpful and made our stay really easy. Also she let us check in early as our flight was super early and we were going to the Melbourne cup.
Loved this place, the view alone from the front deck in the morning at night is gorgeous. The folded toilet paper was a nice touch. Very warm and cozy home. Would come back.

Great location, transport at door. Easy walk to river, casino and DFO shops.
Unfortunately they were doing road works overnight so a little noisy.

Would definitely stay again, good value.
Martine is very friendly, welcoming and helpful, communicates clearly and makes great sourdough, even for special occasions!

Great location. Walking distance to the CBD and a stone throw from Southbank. Lily was a very responsive host. The building of tis apartment is really well kept. The apartment was clean, easy to access and perfect for 3 couples. We would stay here again if we had something to do in the area.

It was our worst experience in Airbnb. We could not sleep at all. They have started making noise around 12 clock and continue whole night. We have been provided single blanket for 2 persons. But it is true the host was very friendly.

We were here for 3 weeks and loved everything about our stay. Kitty was very accomodating and always responsive from booking to check out. We loved how secure the building was and the pool and sauna were so lovely! The apartment was so clean and had everything we needed including a beautiful view of the nature reserve. It is also located centrally to shops so very easy to navigate. Thank you for a wonderful stay ☺️

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!! Easy check in and follow up messages to ensure we had everything we needed. Clean apartment & perfect location with the tram right out the front. My only suggestion would be an upgrade on the bed as they were two single beds pushed together, it unfortunately meant we slumped into the gap. Apart from that I would definitely stay again & recommend :)

It was my fist AirBNB experience but hence had some issues finding the keybox but instructions were clear, i was new to the area. Loved the apartment, very homely. Loved my stay there.
On the whole, had a very pleasant stay. Host was very helpful and responsive and I would definitely stay again.
Amanda’s place is fantastic. Great location, clean, cosy, stylish and just as described in listing. Amanda was great at communicating & provided very clear, detailed instructions and house rules.

Our stay was incredible.
Our host was helpful and friendly. She went above and beyond for us.
We will definitely be back.
Absolutely incredible- in every way! We had the best stay. 100000/10, booking our next stay asap!!

Would absolutely stay here over and over. Kim and Dean's spot was super conveniently located, peaceful at night and perfectly sized for a solo (or duo) traveler.
Cosy, but spacious enough to both relax and, for those who can work from anywhere, get some work done. Will most definitely be back, if they'll have me :)
Thank you!
Michael is a lovely host , very respectful very helpful and gave me lifts when needed highly recommend such a lovely house and goes out of his way to ensure your stay is perfect
Great spot in a great location. First time in Melbourne and felt that this Airbnb was the perfect landing spot. Would definitely return. Loved the personal touches like slippers and welcome sign 😊

Roslyn is one of the best airbnb hosts we've ever had the pleasure to stay with. She was very hospitable, and extremely responsive. She and her family live right next door, and whenever we needed anything, we usually got a response within minutes. Our dog is a lagotto and was quite naughty in finding ways to escape the fenced backyard — and Roslyn was extremely understanding, and she and her son even helped us find Harry and bring him back to the house once when we were out running errands. The home is beautiful, and very healing. The grounds are private, and the drive up to the property is a nice one. The cottage is just nice for a family of four like ours, and very cosy and homely. The home was very nice to stay at, and Roslyn, as I said, was such an amazing host, we would certainly highly recommend staying at Tanglewood Cottage if you have the chance.

Clean, lovely flat, great neighborhood, gracious host. It was what I hoped it would be - a great place from which to launch and regroup. Really enjoyed the vibrant neighborhood and found it easy to navigate from/to without feeling too full of bustle. So many fantastic cafes but it was South Melbourne Market that captivated me, and the park. Highly recommend David’s Artists Studio.
Great cozy place to stay. East walk or drive to the local beach and shops. While I didn’t get to meet Shane & Nuan, they were great in giving us detailed instructions for check in and out.

Absolutely great city stay! The location is perfect for those wanting to explore the city and is a walkable distance from attractions like the Melbourne Museum and Old Melbourne Gaol.
Great little apartment with all of the amenities needed for a comfortable stay.
Only 1 key for 3 people was inconvienent. The pillows where old and need replacing,bath towels where thin. On the good side ,its in a good location.

The apartment was an amazing space, and spotlessly clean,in a cool and vibrant part of town close to the beach, with great places to eat and drink and an easy tram ride into town.  The owners were super friendly and couldn’t have been more helpful and accommodating would not hesitate to recommend or stay here next time I was in Melbourne
Great stay in Fitzroy, had some very minor issues which dean mentioned before we’d arrived which he was able to fix within a few hours - great host
This place was gorgeous and right in the middle of lively Collingwood. I would always recommend the place for exploring and experiencing Melbourne like a local. Thanks for the nice stay :)

Great apartment in a great location for visit to Melbourne. Well managed building. Easy to tour around Melbourne as public transport close by. We enjoyed our visit with a group of four, using the two bedrooms and the fold out couch.

This was a great little hideaway right on southbank within easy reach of the Crown and all the cafes and restaurants. The building is a sandstone treasure with plenty of character and the host decked his apartment out in a retro themed style which suited the residence very well. Will be back.
Good location for shopping, surrounded by shopping malls, Victoria Market, and some CBD tourist attractions within 10 minutes walk.

This place was perfect for a short stay in Melbourne. The place is exactly as the pictures. The location was perfect, super close to Smith and Brunswick streets for all the restaurants and shops. Highly recommend and would stay again.

Beautiful apartment across the street from the beach - very comfortable for a family of four and walking distance to dozens of restaurants. Also close to the tram so getting into Melbourne on public transport is super easy.

the place was well furnished and equipped with all the essentials! great view from the 68th floor too. walkable to many places and very near queen victoria market. had a good and comfortable stay overall!

Tracey’s house was wonderful for our family reunion
Tracey and Mark were very responsive and helpful through our our stay
Thanks so much

Vikki was outstanding.
The cottage was beautiful and very cozy. We will surely be coming back!

The host was very responsive to our inquiries. Easy to check-in and out, clear instructions. Location is superb, near the city, DFO, tram/bus access, groceries store at the lobby. Clean and comfy, great view especially for us staying over the new year's night. Complete amenities by the time we checked in, host also provided the power adapters for our devices from Indonesia :)
Great experience, definitely will choose this place again when in Melbourne.
A nice and clean place to stay! Martine is a friendly host. Will visit back if come to Melbourne again!

Great apartment. Tidy and cosy. The kitchen had enough appliances. Very comfortable bed. Good sofa bed for the kids. 15 minutes walking from St Kilda beach. 3 minutes by car. Tram line available in front of the building. I only recommend asking the building  management for refurbishment of the carpeted common areas.
Jin was super lovely host, was very accommodating and gave me the privacy too. Communication was very prompt.  Beautiful room with the most comfortable bed. A wonderful stay.

Wow ! What a find , beautiful home from home, stunning location, steps from the beach.
A wonderful warm welcome, stunning furnishing, decor, best quality linen, towels, beach towels and bag, infant Catherine has considered everything, making it perfect.
Sit outside for a coffee in the morning, listen to the sea.
Kitchen has everything too, and lovely pretty crockery etc. Candles, Welcome box, water, wine, cheese, biscuits and more totally unexpected but extremely welcome. We will definitely come again.
Oh Transport cards, places to visit, excellent communication and all together fabulous host x

Marc's apartment is in a great location and provides good basic accommodation. Access to transport is easy.
Marc's place is close to all St Kilda has to offer.

Amazing house and perfect for the kids. Lots of activities to do to keep the kids distracted. Narelle was an amazing host and a pleasure to deal with. We would love to come back again. Thank you for having us!!

Great place to stay, very clean , amazing view and nice place, worth to stay.
Recommended 👍👍👍

This air bnb was in a great location with great facilities available. Great to have parking included and although finding the parking spot was daunting at first we quickly got it. A comfortable, very modern and clean apartment with all basic needs supplied.  The pool, gym and recreational facilities were great too although we didn’t have time to use them this time. Would stay again. Thanks Vincent!  😊

Great location. Leaned to use a car lift!
Paul and Dan are accessible and provide clear instrictions and feedback.

The apartment was located perfectly in the city. The view (level 53) includes the Yarra River, a part of the Melbourne Cricket Ground and the Rod Laver Arena to left, and Marvel Stadium/Docklands to the right.
The location has easy access to trams which are very easy walking distances (free within the CBD) as well as a Woolworths Metro right next door to the building lobby. Coles and Aldi are a short walk away as well.
My dealings were with Lihua who was very responsive. I cannot rate them highly enough. Lihua was a solid 10/10 for looking after me and my family. Thank you for being an outstanding host.

The white room felt like a little haven we could escape too after long days spent exploring the city. The bed was very comfortable. The temperature of the room just right and apart from the disturbance of a possum on the roof for two nights, we slept well. The location is excellent. We were close to fantastic eateries on Brunswick and Smith Street. We would happily recommend this place and stay here again.

I booked Jess's place for family members to stay at while here for our wedding. Jess was super helpful and quickly responded to all messages. The location was great, with off street parking and very close access to public transport. My parents were really happy with restaurants and supermarkets within walking distance. My family said they'd love to stay there again next time they visit us. 10/10
A fantastic little house with an amazing view. Everything was communicated extremely well and I thank you for making our stay so great!

Great location, easy access to cafes and restaurants. Shopping centre just around the corner. Great place to stay in CBD
Place itself was clean and tidy. Enough room for four. Would definitely recommend to anyone.

Very easy stay - no issues.
A well presented property with two good sized rooms and bathrooms. Perfect for two couples or two friends.
Close to the tram if you are going to any of the sports venues.
A few cafes on the street which makes it easy to grab a quick coffee or breakfast to start the day.
Nice indoor and outdoor space.
Overall a great stay.

The perfect spot for our visit to Melbourne. Close to great restaurants, amenities and trams into town. Dora was a delightful host who welcomed us onto her home with warmth and generous information. The space was very peaceful & quiet given its proximity to the buzz of the Richmond area. Really comfy bed and all you could need to enjoy your stay. We would visit again and recommend to others.

Warwick is a lovely man who likes to host people and make them feel good.
He's offering breakfast if you want one.
We had a very good stay and could only recommend this place.
If you want to visit Melbourne, it's better to have a car, at least to go to the nearest train station.
Gus is the cutest doggy we've ever seen 😍
Thank you for everything
I had a great stay here with our 8 year old son. He loved the adventure of the place and the hanging chair and cloud bed were very cool. Great central location too!
Excellent spot, quiet and centrally located to walk into the city. The flat is clean, spacious and well equipped.
Fiona's place was absolutely stunning and cosy. She was so easy to communicate with and her house was exactly as described. It was a home away from home!
Great tiny house to chill and relax. Perfect if you want to get out and just enjoy the serenity.

It was lovely to stay at Dora’s beautiful apartment! The loft layout and the plants make it so unique and fun. Dora was really friendly and generous. Looking forward to coming back at some time in the future!

Lisa had a beautiful flat, fully equipped kitchen and an extensive dvd collection! the bathroom was beautiful and everything was exactly as pictured and descibed prior to my arrival. Thanks lisa! this was easily one of the best stays ive had on airbnb!

Stayed here for two days with family and my infant, it was beautiful place to stay! Everything was clean, accomodating to small children and very spacious! Kylie was very easy to communicate with and was super friendly! Can’t recommend more! It was more than worth the price! Will stay there again! Thank you!

We were the strawberry farm for a wedding we were involved with elsewhere in the Yarra Valley. The stay was restful and restorative. The whole weekend a welcome break from our complex lives. Andrea really looked after us. Garden & house an inspiration.

Sally n Ronnie's house was very comfortable. Especially, the bedding was so comfortable that I was able to sleep very comfortably.
The tableware was also kept so clean that it was good to make food. The mart and shopping center are a 1minute walk away, so it was very convenient. I recommend Sally n Ronnie's house to many travelers.
Had a beautiful stay at the tiny house. Loved the small, thoughtful touches. Thanks for having us.

We enjoyed our four night stay at Rob and Libby’s accomodation. We were visiting our son and daughter-in-law and granddaughter who were close by. It was very comfortable and suited our needs.
Rob and Libby were very welcoming and we appreciated their kindness in providing a light supper for us on our late arrival.

Fiona’s property makes a fantastic place for a relaxing getaway! The property was modern, beautifully designed, and felt like home. It was  very cosy and spacious and had everything that we needed. We would highly recommend this place for anyone who is looking to stay in South Melbourne!
Great stay. Apartment was in a great location adjacent Southern across Station and heart of cbd. Thoroughly enjoyed.

Good place to stay with a good view. Little expensive and not as many condiments for general living as I expected for the price and period of stay. Think I was given 3 different contacts for key pick up and they were late, not really any hospitality or care with the booking or overall experience. Its not a bad place to stay for the convenience and the facilities . You would expect more for the price and some basic hospitality and or more condiments for daily use.

We happened to stay just when storms cut all the power, not just in the local area but across the state. Despite this, the stay was romantic, cosy and the view from the large windows out into the forest was just beautiful.  The hosts came down to check on us and brought candles which was nice. Hope to be back, next time when theres no huge storms!
The landlord is very communicative and can help solve any problems. The room was very clean and there was no noise when sleeping at night. It was a great experience for traveling!

This room is located on the top floor and the view is amazing.
The location of this apartment is also great.
Thank you very much.
Guoyun was very helpful and very responsive to questions and messages. Lovely apartment close to Southern Cross Station

Absolutely prime location to stay if attending events at the MCG, 5 minute safe walk to the stadium. Apartment was beautiful and in a quiet location. Great communication from our hosts!  They went out of their way to make our stay comfortable. We will definitely be returning, thank you Marc & MJ for our first Air BnB experience!  Andrea & Kayla

Great location! Nicole was also easily accessible and very helpful when we had an issue with the parking permit. Great place for 4 people. Don't recommend 6 staying though as the sofa bed is not very comfortable. We could feel the springs though the thin matteress.  There was only one roll of toilet paper for 6 girls so we had to buy own own, but this would be easy for the host to fix.
Here is so great! We had a wonderful time here! Ryan is nice and kind! Looking forward to staying here again!

perfect apartment for a trip to Melbourne. Communication was very great and friendly, after hour check - in went smoothly and apartment was very spacious. Walkable Distance to all major attractions and great coffee spots 😊
Great affordable spot in a great part of the city. Martine is kind and easy to interact with. The sourdough bread is such a nice touch!

I enjoyed my stay, the room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. The accomudation was very handy for tram just street. The host was friendly, and I would book this again without hesitation.

Great location and lovely apartment.
Was a bit of hassle trying to pick up and drop off key to a different location when we had a lot of luggage and a baby.
Also aircon was only in the living room. No fan or aircon in bedrooms.
Other than that enjoyed our stay.

This is our 2nd stay here & as before it met all our expectations. Walking distance to hotels , cafes & shops. Short walk to tram stop which goes right into the city. Great communication from hosts. Looking to stay again. Recommended.

Great location, clear instructions, washing machine and tumble drier was a great added extra as travelling and need to use. Property a little tired looking and in need of a little update. Stand alone Aircon unit requires window to be open, which left me on edge as low balcony bar for window and I had my 4 year daughter with me.
very satisfied with stay. Thank you Nicole!

Glenbrook Cottage provided us a wonderful retreat in Warburton. The view is more beautiful than the pictures can describe. The house is spacious and private. We loved seeing the wildlife everyday. We look forward to visiting again.
Very good place to stay! Had some problems with a key and Nicole was there to help within 5 minutes. Very helpful and great location to stay at.

Perfect staycation for family of 6 adults. close to trams & DFO Spencer Street.
Host was very responsive & accommodating. Instructions to access building & carpark were very clear.
No surprises, and quite a nice and cosy home. Would recommend to friends looking to stay in the area
The accommodation is clean and comfortable, has a good view, and the transportation is very convenient. I want to visit again if I have the chance!

The apartment is located on a high floor and sunny with clear views of the neighborhood. It has a very nice terrace. The apartment is quiet in the otherwise bustling CBD. Endless eating choices and centrally located to the CBD attractions. We didn’t even take the free tram (we like to walk).
Second time, feels a bit like home already! Super nice place and location - super easy and smooth communication with Denise! I‘ll be back!
Location was perfect right by the botanic gardens on the cutest street. The flat was nicely decorated. Shame the balcony wasn’t able to be used, but the natural light was great.

Carly has an amazing house, very cosy and comfortable. She was very flexible with check in and very helpful in giving me directions to the house. The location is good as there is a coles and Aldi nearby and the bus takes you straight into town.

Great location, spectacular views of Melbourne with  easy access to public transport and apartment was clean & better than the pictures.  So close to restaurants, cafes & retail with lots to choose from.   Accommodation was value for money.  Communication with Russell and instructions was easy.  Made our weekend at F1 so good.  Would come again.

We stayed for a few nights during the Melbourne F1 Grand Prix.  Kieran was easy to deal with and very helpful when we asked for a late checkout. The place was fantastic and very close to central Melbourne. Overall a great place to stay. Would highly recommend

Addison’s communication was fantastic, helped us out with everything that was asked, gave us a few tips of local transport options and directions on where to find things, the unit was clean and tidy and looked as the pictures showed. The unit is in a very central location and within walking distance to southern cross station and the trams.
Would recommend this to anyone looking to stay in the Dockland area.
Thank you Addison for your hospitality it was greatly appreciated. Will be back for sure in the future.

Had a great stay at Wendy’s place! So much space for 4 people, it was great. The view from the balcony is beautiful, so highly recommend being around at sunset. A perfect stay if spending time in St Kilda!
Amazing property. Very spacious, spotless and couldn’t ask for a better place to stay. Beautiful and peaceful surroundings. Penelope was so responsive and helpful and I would highly recommend
Excellent location, very clean, very little noise and superb pillows and bed. The staff were friendly and most helpful.

Away with children, the wifi did not work and I contacted the owner he stated that it must of been a network problem, we restarted it and still no change. TV antenna wasn’t good could t get any channels but only had channel 7 on free tv, which also wasn’t great with kids. The house was clean and everything else was great.
Furniture a bit dated but everyone slept fine
Great location - I noticed a bit of tram noise in the mornings, and party noise at night  as I am a really light sleeper I took my ear plugs and slept well.
The place is nice with all necessary  amenities.  The host are responsive. They  replace a new hair dryer very quick after I found out there was not hair dryer at the place.

My folks recently stayed at Marc & MJ's place in East Melbourne for a week during their visit, and they thoroughly enjoyed their time there. The hosts were incredibly welcoming and accommodating, and always responsive.
The apartment itself was lovely—clean, cozy, and equipped with all the necessary amenities. The location was also fantastic, with easy access to everywhere.
Overall, my parents had a wonderful experience at Marc & MJ's place and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable stay in Melbourne.
Large comfortable well appointed home located close to tram train and shops and motorway. Great heating system.

Jun’s place was exactly as pictured online. It was in the best location and had everything we needed. Jun was also really easy to communicate with. Super quick responses and she even offered us late check out. The stay was amazing!

Thank you Roslyn for the most relaxing stay. The beautifully styled cottage is set amongst the most manicured gardens, looking onto the paddock with Buddy the gorgeous pony and Barry and his fellow sheep. We felt so relaxed exploring the garden, enjoying our BBQ watching the sunset and Sunny our Golden Retriever absolutely loved his visits from Albert. Roslyn was a fantastic and welcoming host and we're heading home feeling very refreshed! Thank you again, Luke, Courtney & Sunny
Lovely place and we enjoyed the stay very much. Will certainly book this place again when travelling to MSAC
this place is private, quiet and has a tram to the city directly out the front. This was such an easy booking, and had everything we needed.

Location was amazing albeit the background noise of a busy city, mainly the trams and trains surrounding it. The reception was perfect as well as the living space itself. Amenities were provided whenever required, and they were very responsive in the app chat. Very well worth the price, would recommend picking this place out.
Great location & clean. Bit smaller than I thought but fine for 2 adults & 2 kids. Nicole was great & really helpful
Peter was ill when I stayed so I didn't get to meet him but his place was lovely. Very cosy and full of character. very close to the city centre with lots of bars and restaurants nearby.
Great place with great views, owner responded quickly and was helpful, also got a late check out which was great!

The listing was in a perfect location for exploring Melbourne. We really couldn't have been in a better place with all the laneways, great food and facilities literally at our doorstep. The apartment is spacious and comfortable. A great place for a quick Melbourne getaway!

The room was very clean and tidy, exactly same as photos. The carpark is also available for us. Usually hard to find the parking in cbd so that was good for us.
Host was also amazing, always available for our response.
That was amazing stay in this airbnb. Thank you.

It's the second time we have stayed in one of Nick's apartments and it was as good as always.
Communication was excellent and the place was immaculate.
I highly recommend Nick's places.

My city hideaway is one of the best airbnb I have ever stayed in - I actually never wanted to leave! Beautifully curated, amazing location, comfy beds. Fiona is an excellent host! Would highly recommend.

The stable is a new and a fantastic air b n b. Amanda has created a beautifully presented place to stay. It feels very comfortable and the attention to detail makes it stand out amongst a lot of air b n b’s that we have stayed in. The amenities are new, spotless and it’s incredibly well equipped. The stable feels very homely and we were immediately comfortable.
Fitzroy is an amazing place to stay, absolutely full of amazing food and drink spots, which it would take me an age to list. Discover these for yourself but honestly we found it hard to even leave East Melbourne.
Finally Amanda is a lovely host so communicative friendly and helpful! Absolutely how air b n b should be done and made our stay so easy. We’ll be back for sure!

Appreciate the efforts to amend a couple of issues that had unexpectedly surfaced during my stay. Feedback was taken well to ensure the quality and comfort for future guests.
Fireplace was my favourite. Cheers Sharon 🙂

We loved our stay at this property. It was located close to tram stops, train stations and restaurants. Also within walking distance of Bourke St Mall, museums and many tourist attractions. The unit was furnished well and included all the amenties you need for a home away from home. I would definitely stay here again.
James was a great proactive host, he was always helpful and answered any messages promptly.

Great location for our night in town. Very helpful and accurate with instructions for parking and accessing apartment.
The place was spotless and the views amazing. Very comfortable amenities.
Would highly recommend!
Jun is a very nice and reactive host. The apartment is right in the CBD with a garage, very important if you are travelling with a car!

Lisa's place is a very cosy 2 bedrooms unit, in a very quiet suburb of Melbourne. The nights were really peaceful.
Halfway between the airport and the CBD, every Melbourne's places are a short distance from it.

I stayed here for 3 days. This a quiet and artistic neighborhood, and the accommodation that Sean provided is so clean and comfortable. Plus traffic here is also super convenient and near the city area. If I were to visit Melbourne next time, I’ll definitely settle here again!

We had a lovely break in Melbourne, enjoyed the view from the Apartment .
It was quiet and comfortable and in a great location.
Would recommend it , and stay again .
Great stay for a girls weekend, perfect location. Beds super comfortable. Cara was super responsive and great to have flexibility on check in and check out time
The apartment is on a busy road but still very quite on the inside! The parking is a bonus. The only downsides is the couch as it not comfortable.

Thanks for another great stay.
My go to place to stay when in Melbourne for work-
Beautifully decorated and really comfortable bed.
All my favourite restaurants close by.
See you again soon.

It was an absolute pleasure exploring this beautiful place with my family and loved ones.
Made my 40th celebration so special
Thank you for letting me create new memories in your place ❤️

The location was great for us, close to family in Northcote. Loved the coffee shop outside, easy access to transport, lovely comfy beds. More general maintenance is required.

Great location; highly recommended if your purpose for visiting Melbourne is to visit Melbourne Park/MCG as it is literally across the road. Correspondingly, the city is walking distance but there is a tram stop right outside... Nicole was very easy to communicate with, clear and concise. All and all, awesome stay, thanks!
Michelle's apartment is in a great, and funky, location. We had an amazing weekend and she has great recommendations of some rad eats around Melbourne!

A beautiful weekend getaway that was personalised and a lovely intentional touch. The tiny house is private and an amazing view of the surrounding paddocks and hills from the open decking that you can relax on while sipping a glass of red looking out to the peaceful view.
We really enjoyed our stay and appreciated the personal touches. Thanks so much ☺️🌿

Geo is an awesome host. We are a family with 2 young kids and travelling with the young ones can be a bit uneasy, however Geo's prompt responses & flexibility made the whole experience very comfortable.
Our whole family was at ease since the moment we checked in, to the moment we checked out, all thanks to Geo & his team's exceptional customer service.
We would highly recommend this property (especially with a host like Geo) to anyone visiting Melbourne :)

Small unit but suitable for 5 people. Easy and closer by the city!
The car park is a little bit asian food smells!
Brilliant location and the perfect sized space for four. We loved our stay here, Phillip was a fantastic host and responded quickly to all messages. Thank you
Andrea was the perfect host.  so friendly and helpful.  We will be back for another stay as soon as we can.   My family and I found the property exceeded expectations.

Very close to Queen's markets, easy to find and beautiful cozy little room. Peter was quick in answering me and let me check-in early despite having booked the place the same very day. Also he's very nice and friendly!

This is a great spot for a working holiday. The apartment is just as described. It is very comfortable and the kitchen is well-equipped. The location is very convenient – close to shops, restaurants, the Brunswick Baths pools and a short tram ride into town.

Overall the stay was terribly basic. However there were a few issues:
- Toilet seat in ensuite bathroom was broken upon arrival, attempted fix by maintenance, was told seat was only useable with care
- Second key was requested prior to stay and was originally promised by host. A few days prior to stay was informed this was no longer possible which was very inconvenient
- No salt and pepper was available as reported on listing. Also no facial tissues available.
Other than that no other issues with stay or place

great location , close to CBD , 10 minute walk to crown. Lovely clean, beds were great, could do with some wine glasses. Not for people with knee issues , 3 levels stairs.
We really enjoyed our stay

Our stay at this location was great, the host was super responsive and helpful. The location was perfect for people wanting to utilise public transport to get around, close to lots of restaurants. Would recommend to anyone wanting somewhere to stay while exploring the city.

This is a truly exceptionable Airbnb. It has been artfully decorated and has every (high-quality) appliance you could possibly need. The location is incredibly central. Giang is a very responsive and helpful host. Staying here made our trip a joy. We look forward to returning. Thank you.

We had a great time staying here in Preston. It is a spacious house where my family and friends, a group of eight, stayed together. The house is beautiful, clean, modern, and every room has its own en-suite bathroom.
The kitchen is fully equipped, and most importantly, it’s conveniently located near Bell station.
Thank you to the host for being friendly, responding quickly, and providing helpful recommendations.
I highly recommend this accommodation for large groups. : )👍

We had a pleasant stay at this apartment. The location was fantastic, close to many amenities and attractions. The apartment itself was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The host was very responsive and accommodating.
However, one minor issue we encountered was that the blinds were not blackout blinds, which made it difficult to completely darken the room. This was a bit challenging for us as we were traveling with a baby who needed a darker room to sleep.
Lovely apartment and very clean! In the middle of the city center so that you can reach a lot by walking! I definitely would come back :)

We enjoyed the location of our apartment . The balcony was lovely facing the greenery across the road and the kitchen was a great size with lots of space to move around . We would thoroughly recommend this apartment for your stay .
Great location. Friendly staff. The unit could be cleaner but otherwise okay. Thanks for the stay!
Lovely place, very responsive and attentive staff. Some issues with noisy pipes, received a partial refund. seems it's better value to book directly through the website than Airbnb. I'd stay again

I really enjoyed my stay here. The location of this studio flat is really perfect for a Melbourne trip: I was mainly there for a conference at the University of Melbourne so it was an easy walk. I loved being able to pop over the road for a swim at the Fitzroy pool at the end of the day, and it was easy to find things to eat nearby. Surprisingly quiet and peaceful for such an inner city spot. I was travelling by myself this time and it felt very safe.

It was rather late that day around 8:30pm when we checked in but Karen still welcomed us happily and brought us around her house to see if we can see some wildlife around. She even provide story books for my son which was a very nice gesture. The house was warm and clean, the view out of the house was spectacular especially when we saw the kangaroos hopping across the field in front. Nice place, fantastic host, recommended to go for nature lovers.

Great location, and the host was friendly and accommodating, offering us a discount due to the property's condition. However, the cleanliness was disappointing, with sticky floors in the bathroom and kitchen. Additionally, the internet was very slow, which made it difficult to stay connected. This place has potential if the cleaning and internet issues are addressed.

This was the perfect place for 9 of us 5 adults and 4 children, spacious and with great amenities including a public pool sauna spa and gym which was perfect in the 40d heat.
The apartment is very well equipped with everything you could need, and the area is perfect easy walk and access to every where in the city and at the doorstep of Carlton.
Highly recommend staying here and we definitely would again .
Thank you Katie you made our stay so easy you were very quick to respond and very helpful.

This place was excellent! Very modern and updated, exactly as described in the listing. Very very clean and many extra special touches like fresh milk in the fridge, extra towels, high end shampoo/conditioner/soap, laundry and dish soap, and even an adorable crib set up for my youngest. The location was great, steps from groceries and a park and a short drive into central Melbourne.

The Canvas team were excellent with great communication. The apartment had all the amenities you need for a stay in Melbourne. Great city location that is within walking distance to cafes, restaurants, bars and tourist attractions. Would highly recommend for solo travellers and couples.
It’s very convenient to travel around Melbourne staying in the CBD. It was a nice apartment hotel with friendly staff.

Kayhan’s house became our home away from home for over a month while we were staying as a family, in Melbourne. Kayhan was very helpful and proactive, friendly and accomodating, and let our dog stay too. The house is very comfortable, and has all the needed amenities/appliances. It is in a great location- with public transport right outside and many parks in short walking distance. Nestled between Kew, Camberwell, Balwyn- everything is conveniently at your doorstep. We really loved our time here- and if you’re a family, it’s a great place to be based and explore.
We had a nice stay. Some areas were impeccably clean but some were dustier than we would have hoped. Overall it is clear that a lot of care in taken by the hosts.

Our stay here was fantastic. The bed was very comfortable, it was quiet, we had a great view of the pool and the tram was right out the front making it very handy to get into the city. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed.
Place as described. Proactive property managers.  Didn't have any problems.  Would go back again.

Unit was comfortable and well appointed. Great location.
Areas for improvement- the door latch was broken and unable to lock from the inside.
Enjoyed the stay, thanks for your help Ayfer.

Apartment stinks like BO! I’m talking the couch, beds, linen and blankets. Apartment needs a deep clean.
Shower has black mould.
Great location but apartment definitely needs some attention.

The apartment is what you see and get. Fabulous views and easy walking to restaurants and cafe's. The kitchen wasn't as well stocked with utensils for a party of five people and our fridge ice maker failed. Also we understand a complex like this has a focus on safety and why an induction was necessary.... but only two evenings in the week to do this?  when you are most likely to be out and about enjoying Melbourne, definitely disappointing. Suggest to enjoy the facilities that we didn't, pool, movie theater etc, make sure you book to allow for the one hour induction and the two available days of the week they happen. Otherwise you will be pleasantly surprised with the location and views.

The apartment was immaculate & provided you don’t suffer from a fear of heights or vertigo the views are phenomenal!! Beds were comfy too.
Byo tea/coffee/sugar/milk & water bottle.

Exceptional host, memorable experience for our family! Brigitte and John went out of their way for us, from getting us onto the Puffing Billy when our ride got cancelled, to sharing their fresh picked fruits in their beautiful farm, homemade goodiessss and inviting us into their beautiful home to see Kobi. The cabin itself was spotlessly clean, very comfortable beds, kitchen was so well equipped even pampering us with lots of coffee capsules, fresh berries, assortment of tea.
Brigitte and John welcomed us into their farm on Christmas Day, with presents waiting in the cabin! So generous, so thoughtful and it was a trip to remember for our family. We even had cookies and fruitcake to bring home, it was really our good fortune to have met Brigitte and John’s family. Baby Luca was really adorable and the whole family was so friendly ❤️

Yarradene is an amazing luxury house, in a quiet location with amazing natural surroundings. The house itself is beautiful and well equipped, we could not ask for anything more. Shane is a super host who is responsive, helpful and has lots of great recommendations! Would love to come back again next time we are in Healesville!

10/10 stay! The property itself is breathtaking, not to mention the city views it has to offer,  we felt at home as soon as we turned the key and opened the door. The location is right in the heart of prahran, with  everything at your doorstep with amazing shops, restaurants, and nightlife just steps away. The host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and made sure everything ran smoothly. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to be in the centre of it all!

Had a fantastic stay in Queenies apartment. The location is walking distance to Southern Cross and the views are exceptional. Facilities were all available (gym, sauna, steam and pool) which added to the stay.

We loved the apartment. It was super cozy and every single thing that you can think of was available in the house. The location is full of life with restaurants and public transport very close by. The view from the house blew us away - beautiful sunsets, skyline view, MCG view , hot air baloons and the new year fireworks all from the balcony. Russell is am amazing host and provided all instructions clearly and proactively. He was extremely kind and helpful. If I come back to Melbourne, I won't think twice before staying here and will recommend the house to anyone I know. Thank you Russell for everything.
Good place to stay with family , have all the basics amenities… near to city… overall a good place to stay….
very nice little place, very clean and organised, had every amenity needed. overall very pleased with the place and host

Sparsely furnished with cheap basics. Huge heavy main bed. No space to move around . We stubbed our shins and toes several times!
Mismatched Crockery was mostly cracked and well worn. Eg only 3 mugs of which 2 were cracked. No juice glasses or tumblers. It reminded us of Backpacker hostels.
I washed 2 entire pillows (took 3 days to dry out) and pillow protectors.
Great location and surroundings. The property was clean and in perfect condition. Hosts were amazing and very hospitable... we will definitely be returning.
Our family had a lovely and comfortable stay at Simone’s apartment . . it was well appointed and close to transport and located in a leafy and quiet street!

I was at this property with my family for the last two nights, I can say this was a nice, clean and family-friendly accommodation in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Close to shopping centre, this house has everything one needs during their stay.

Location was perfect for enjoying the Chapel St district. Train station nearby was also convenient for my quick trip to the city. A very comfortable stay in a beautiful and newly furnished townhouse. I would love to stay here longer next time.

Charlotte was the perfect host who responded to a couple of my questions immediately and with answers. I appreciate that everything was perfectly as described, and that everything was very clean 🧼 Thank you for having us 🩷

It is on a very nice location - very accessible to everything especially to the main transport hub — Southern Cross Station (where you also take the SkyBus to the airport). The place is also really well kept and tidy, and has all the main amenities and equipment. Peter was also very responsive (even past 11pm which I felt real sorry about) and provided very clear instructions. Will come back next time when I'm in Melbourne!

Really nice Airbnb, hosts check in instructions and communication was excellent.
Great location, so convenient being above Woolworths.
No complaints!

We loved our stay here in Melbourne! It’s so centrally located with great restaurants and lots to do just a short walk away. We felt very comfy and at home at this apartment and would definitely stay here again!

This property is right in the heart of the city. Great eats and amazing atmosphere at your door. Great space to rest after a big day of tennis and shopping. We love staying at Tom + Susanna's. Will be back again in May.

This is a great room for the price. Great location. Very comfortable beds and everything you need for a comfortable city stay.
The pool was a lot better than I expected.
Would stay again
Michelle's place is everything I expected and more. I loved the space and experience. Many thanks Michelle.
Kevin was an exemplary host, this is easily the best place we have stayed at since beginning to use AirBnB. Would recommend to everyone.
I love this lovely house and really enjoyed staying there. Anna is so kind and always respond so quickly. The house looks exactly the same as the photos she taken!

Amazing beautiful house. Very clean, roomy bedrooms excellent location. Coles was a minute walk. Restaurants and train station 10 mins walk. 20mins car ride to Melbourne CBD. Absolutely loved the place. Will be back again.

The cottage is really lovely - clean, plenty of space, well equipped and close to walking/riding tracks. There was plenty of room for my two dogs as well. Shaun communicated promptly and was always friendly. Highly recommend. We loved our stay.

Lovely spot for one. Right in between stops for the tram and train into the city. Nice pub and cafe just around the corner yet the loft is in a pretty, tree lined, quiet street. Super clean and really nicely decorated with a very comfy bed. Was really nice to meet the host Denise.

Sonny was a great host who was helpful and easy to communicate with. The Airbnb was spotlessly clean and well set up for a comfortable stay. His attention to detail and effort to go beyond what was expected was so appreciated - home cooked muffins on arrival, milk in the fridge and fresh fruit were just some of the special touches that show how much Sonny cares about giving his guests a good experience. Being located directly opposite Chadstone shopping centre was also extremely convenient. Thank you, hope to stay again when we are next visiting our family in Melbourne.

Fantastic apartment in a very central yet quiet location. A multitude of restaurants and cafes within walking distance. Close to St Kilda and not far from the city either. Samantha is prompt with her responses to any queries and was extremely accommodating with our very late check-in time and letting us store our bags. I would thoroughly recommend this accommodation for singles or a couple. Samantha was the perfect host.

It’s a beautiful place just expensive for the location.
For us it worked perfectly as we were moving house and needed a place to crash near by and this was all that was available.
If you’re from out of town and have no reason to be in Elsternwick then it may not suit.
Awesome communication and very friendly
Excellent location, a very welcome place. So organized and clean, we were able to have our breakfast in its cozy terrace.

The stay was very nice, we paid around $400 for the 3 night stay. The apartment was clean, however there was a bit of mould at the back of the toilet seat and on the walls in the bathroom, but it didn’t phase us!
It’s in walking distance of lots of places, and has a tram stop right out side for convenience:)
I would probably come back here again

Was as described very family friendly quiet neighbourhood
2 Lots of shops Both could be within walking distance depending your level of fitness.
The design and furniture layer was good as not overclauded.
Many appliances and items in the kitchen
the in door and semi out door lounge is a big plus
Magical,  romantic location with spacious rooms. Beautifully appointed and had everything you could need.

This apartment was exactly what I was looking for! Ideal for longer stays because it has a great little kitchen and a washer and dryer. The bed, pillows and linens were super comfy, bathroom was clean, there was plenty of space to put my stuff and spread out. Phillip and Bree were excellent hosts...communicative and fast to respond. Couldn't have asked for a better pick for my stay in Melbourne.

We had a wonderful stay at David's apartment! The place was spotlessly clean, equipped with everything we needed and in a great location. David is an amazing host and really looks after his guests, especially with his communication :) Highly recommended!

Great accommodation, everything as described, peaceful but right in the middle of interesting areas. No fuss check in and lovely personal touches such as small packets of tea, washing up liquid etc. Balcony a great asset for views from 43 floor. And really appreciated smooth communication with hosts! Simply perfect!

We loved our stay at this apartment, so close to the beach but quiet and peaceful still. The apartment had everything you'd need, including laundry supplies, all the basic kitchen needs and bathroom essentials too. Sam was a responsive and helpful host. We'd recommend the cafe opposite for breakfast/coffee too. Some lovely little restaurants within walking distance in Hampton or a short taxi ride away in Brighton. Would highly recommend staying here!

The unit was clean and comfortable with great amenities. Although one reason we selected it was because it is a ground floor unit assuming it would have easy access for my 76 year old Mum with bad knees - beware the stairs.

This accomodation was perfect for us: comfortable and right on the doorstep of Sydney Rd, so exploring cafes, bars, restaurants and shops was very easy. Nice little neighbourhood park next door. Luke was an awesome host. Offered fantastic local recommendations upon request, sorted a Myki card for us to use whilst there for public transport which was very generous, and accommodated a request for a late checkout. Super easy and friendly to deal with, couldn’t recommend more.

Sam’s place is in the CBD and walkable to everything including Southern cross station, Victoria market, Yarra river attractions and everything else in cbd. The apartment itself was bigger than most and with a nice balcony, nicely furnished and comfortable. The car park provided though pricey (aud 30 per day)was nearby and convenient on a side street.

The apartment was clean, comfortable, and everything was in great shape.  Beds were comfy. Showers were great. There was plenty in the kitchen for breakfast and snacks, but cooking a full meal might be a little challenging. The apartment is in a fantastic location.  But, one  of the reasons that the location is great is that two tram lines run right next to the building.  As the apartment is on the 13th floor, we didn’t find this to be a problem. If you are a light sleeper, it might be an issue.

Great location! Just right across Southern Cross Station which is like the central train station in Melbourne. Felt very comfortable inside the unit. Parking was a bit difficult to do due to a complicated parking space structure.

Absolutely amazing apartment. It was everything we could have wanted and more. Beautifully designed and furnished, the accomodation was equiped with everything you may possibly need from an iron to pots and pans. The facilities (pool, gym, outdoor area/running track) were a perfect touch to our getaway. The host, Bethany, was so lovely and her communication was second to none.

Great location for getting out and about. The room was clean and tidy,
The building itself was a little run down and very busy in the lifts with only 2 lifts working.
Sam was a great host and was very responsive with our queries.
Also allowing us to leave our luggage for a small fee.
Beautiful place and very easy to commute from with the tram station directly outside of the apartment. Would definitely stay again.
Sam is a very friendly person who actively communicates with guests and solves problems in a timely manner. Provided us with a pleasant accommodation experience during our trip.

a nice area, extremely convenient having a woolies right below. the gym and pool/spa were nice and easy to access. the condo itself wasn’t the best kept, cleaners definitely don’t spend enough time in there cleaning considering what was paid, could do with more attention to detail
This is a convenient, excellent apartment in clean condition. I think it’s excellent value and you certainly get what you pay for.
Our stay was amazing. The views are amazing and the place was very organised and clean. The wifi barely worked though.

This place is on a beautiful property. We loved being able to explore the whole 30 acres and had no reason to leave. Perfect for a large family gathering.
Barbara was a great host!

Great view overlooking the valleys and mountains. Inside has spacious living and dining areas and s lovely old world feel as per the photos which suits the property. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

Overall good value for money. Nice location. Apartment was dusty, looks like cleaners are only tidying. There was a musty smell and mold in the bathroom. The apartment is in need deep clean. Aircon doesn't work very well so I'd avoid in the hot months.
We had a last minute change to our reservation and Canvas made this really easy for us. The apartment was gorgeous and right in the middle of the city. Highly recommend staying here!

The room has a beautiful night view and is very refreshing. 🌃The layout of the house is reasonable, the area is suitable, the access control system guarantees security, and it is very suitable for visiting Melbourne. 😊The house is located in the center of the city, so it is very easy to get anywhere, and there are many modes of transportation to choose from🫰❤️. The host of the house gave us a warm reception and the online response was very timely and solved our problem. If you are visiting Melbourne, this is a good choice!👍🏻

Fantastic location and very comfortable accommodation. The apartment was well equipped and perfect for a family. Hosts Vinola and Sookie were absolutely delightful. Thank you so much for a lovely stay!

Giang’s place truly encompasses the French vibe and it is so adorable. A very responsive host and helped me when there was anything that came up. I loved the location because everything in the CBD was walking distance. I would highly recommend this place!

We really loved our stay. The location was very ideal, super close to the beach. Check in was very easy too. The aircon was very much appreciated and the general space was really nice.
Additionally, comms with Paolo was a breeze. Highly recommended stay!

-Great location
-Everything as advertised
-Firmish but comfortable bed
-Great value
-Very helpful with an early check in and getting the keys to us at the airport
-would stay here again
As Karen states in her description, this is not a fancy place. But on a super hot weekend it was clean and relatively comfortable (maybe some new pillows)

Having stayed in or around the Frankston area several times before we knew what we were looking for & this place fitted the bill perfectly. Very peaceful and spacious with comfy beds & we felt at home straight away. The added bonus of a garage was useful as we had loaned a car.
I had trouble with one of the blinds but Yanina was very responsive and helpful about it.
TV, dishwasher, washing machine & A/C all easy to use.
There’s a supermarket about a 20 minute walk or 3 minute drive so super handy.
We will certainly reach out to Yanina for our next trip to Oz.

Philip and Bree were very responsive and friendly during our stay - cannot thank them enough!
The room is in great location to use the free trams and has an amazing view. Amenities and cooking utensils were great since we stayed over a week. Would 100% recommend to anyone traveling Melbourne 😊

We had a wonderful stay at Kaye’s! Both her and her husband are lovely. The house is extremely clean and private and in a beautiful part of Diamond Creek. We loved how Kaye provided some delicious  home made goodies and feel that it was exceptional value for money and would definitely stay again! Thanks Kaye and Steve

Lovely base with nice cafes and restaurants a short walk or tram away. Lyndall is a very friendly host and gave some great recommendations. Despite being in a lively area the little courtyard was very quiet and peaceful. Bed was very clean and comfortable :)
Great place to stay - close to the train station, beach and restaurants/ shops - would definitely stay again

Justin’s place is incredibly convenient and served its purpose for our weekend. A slight deep clean wouldn’t go astray but the bookshelf and all the nic naks were incredible to look over. If we ever needed a space with a large living / common area I wouldn’t hesitate to book again!

Location was perfect and an easy walk to the shops.
The place was super clean and tidy, and exactly how described. It was a wonderful experience for myself. Highly recommend
Laura was also so wonderful with her replies and so quick
Brilliant stay - just as described and so easy when coming from the airport ☺️ the place was spotless and the amenities exceeded expectations! Thank you
Loved our stay! Perfect for our family. Was a super convenient walk to get where we needed to be

I had a very good stay! The place was neat, clean, and well-maintained. It felt safe and comfortable throughout. The host was great, making the experience even better. Highly recommend it to everyone!

The apartment was exactly what we needed at that time. Eduardo was very responsive and friendly. The apartment is not one of the modern style ones, could use an upgrade, but it was equipped with everything one needs. We really enjoyed our stay and definitely would book it a second time.
Fantastic location. So close to coffe shops, delicious food & bars. Despite being in the centre of Melbourne the apartment was quite & the beds were so comfortable. I'd definitely stay again

I had a great experience staying at Alix and Taj's Airbnb! From the moment I booked, they were very responsive and proactive, making sure to check in with us regularly to ensure we were comfortable throughout our stay. Their attention to detail really stood out.
The apartment itself is in a prime location, surrounded by plenty of amenities like cafes, supermarkets, and more, making it incredibly convenient for daily needs. It's also within walking distance to several main attractions, which was a huge plus.
A special shout-out to Alix and Taj for helping us secure parking for the entire duration of our stay at a very reasonable price. Overall, this accommodation as per my expectations, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a great stay in the area!

The property is simply breathtaking! We stayed here for our wedding weekend and had everything we needed, it was peaceful and watching the sunset from the hill is incredible. Highly recommend the property for a bridal party or a simple get away with friends and/or family

The accomodation is nicer than it looks in photos. My friend and I stayed for three days and we had an easy checkin/depature. The location is central and bed was super comfy. It definitely felt like we were at a hotel for a fraction of the price. The hosts were super easy to contact and inviting. I’d reccomend for anyone wanting to come to melbourne. Thankyou

The perfect base for exploring the Yarra Valley, Dandenong Ranges, and Puffing Billy.
The cabin was spotless, comfortable, and well-equipped, but it was the little touches that made our stay so special—like a delicious home-baked cake, honey cookies (so good!), fresh figs (delicious!), lemons, passionfruit, and even toddler toys for our 2 year old!
Brigitte went above and beyond, helping us secure Puffing Billy tickets when they were sold out online and sharing fantastic local recommendations (We will remember our sons cackles at Seville water park for many years to come!). Her hospitality made our weekend absolutely perfect.
If you're looking for a cozy, welcoming retreat with incredible attention to detail, this is the place!
Thank you Brigitte and John for a perfect weekend. We can’t wait to return.

Jade's place is wonderful! A short walk to the heart of Lygon street, trams to the city and just about anything else you could possibly need.
The apartment itself is quiet and well equipped. Would definitely start there again next time I'm in Melbourne
It really did feel like home away from home. A lovely home in a perfect location. Simon was delightful and easy to deal with. The home immaculate!! Definitely recommend staying here

The apartment was the perfect spot for our week spent in Melbourne visiting family and friends. The neighborhood where the apartment is located is a convenient residential area walking distance to cafes and shops. We were also close to two tram lines and a cycling path. Pretty much great access to everything. The apartment was quiet and modern. We would recommend this apartment for stays in Melbourne.
Was just there for a couple of nights but a perfect apartment in a great location. Place was so good that I have already organised to stay there again on my next trip down to Melbourne
The best Airbnb experience I've ever had. Host, apartment, location, host's friends. Absolutely superb. 10 stars.
Great location within walking distance to Southern Cross station and most amenities. Tidy apartment..........highly recommended.

Charlotte & Rowena are great host!
Very responsive since our booking stage and caring. Follow up thoroughly prior check-in, stay through and even after my family check out.
The house is clean and tidy and easy instructions provided on check in process and also how to use the electronic appliance.
We will definitely come back should we visit Melbourne again and also recommend to our friends!

Roslyn went above and beyond to make my husband and I feel comfortable. She was super responsive and even helped me research dog friendly cafes in the area! The photos of the cottage do not do it justice - it is absolutely stunning and you immediately feel comfortable the second you step inside.

Great location, close to shops, cafes and restaurants. Close to transport and venues.
Older building but well presented with security gate and front door lock.
Maree was very helpful and responsive to my questions.
Very happy with our stay! The place was perfect, very clean and exactly like it is described. Awesome location that makes getting around Melbourne very easy
Cosy 4 bedroom home with good amenities. Helped us live out of the family home for the period of stay and it was a breeze.

We stayed at Siobhan’s apartment over the F1 weekend & it was perfect. Location  made it easy to walk to the track & go to the city or casino at night. Lovely, cosy apartment, was perfect for our needs.

Our stay at Collins Escape was more than we could ask for. Super neat apartment in a great location. Susan was very helpful, providing all the necessary info for an easy check in and checkout, as-well as generously leaving us a little present.

The apartment was very nice and comfortable and it was spotlessly clean. Access via a key safe made getting in easy.
It’s on the ground floor with its own little front yard. Direct access to the street meant we didn’t have to walk through the building to get in and out.
Directly over the street is a shopping centre with a big Woolworths, butcher, greengrocer etc plus a street of restaurants (and a tavern) many of which are open late. We thoroughly recommend the Mexican.
Staff were super friendly and the room was spacious and it felt homely. Comfy beds and the apartment complex was super close to everything in the city.
We really enjoyed staying at Fiona‘s place. Close to the Buzzy shops and market but quiet at night. Nicely decorated with a brilliant art collection.

I had the most incredible stay at this apartment. I was blown away by the apartment’s breathtaking view. The floor-to-ceiling windows offered panoramic views of the city and harbour
The apartment itself was immaculate—spacious, modern, and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The host was also extremely welcoming and made sure I had all the information I needed to make my stay as easy and enjoyable as possible.
I would say its equivalent or better than a 5 star hotel stay
Highly recommended for anyone who loves gorgeous views and a top-notch stay! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Tom try to do as much as they can to keep the place nice and clean. The apartment is old, hallway or the building needs refurbishment. Location is amazing, has lots of food and easy access to everywhere, especially free trams around the city. However, due to lots of road and city building works, therefore it will be very noisy. Great location for us. Thank you for a great stay. The only problem was the garage was too small for our hired car. 🚗

Sam's place looks as pics shown. CBD area free tram zone. Everything in the house was great but can be better. Extra heater will be helpful for winter as there's only one wall AC/heater in the whole house. High floor with no block view was amazing. Overall was great.Simple and basic place for a few nights stay.

Deanne & Mike were very friendly & helpful.
They were very flexible and accomodative to our request for extended stay.

Staying at Amanda’s place was heavenly! Such a great location close to Gertrude st shops, cafes, restaurants, and a half hour walk to the NGV! The space is as beautiful as the photos are, lots of natural light, lovely linen, and art work. I loved the interior lighting too, cosy and warm. The bathtub was perfect after big days … I hope I get to stay again as I’ve told so many people to book!
Amanda was lovely to communicate with too.

Had a wonderful few days here, 2 comfortable beds, washing machine, living space, and decked-out kitchen in the centre of Melbourne. Easy to get out and about, as well as back home at the end of the day. Highly recommended!

Michelle kindly answered my last minute request for a long-term stay in minutes. She took the time to great me and gave me plenty of recommendations on places to eat, drink and ways to enjoy Melbourne as she is the 'ultimate Melbourne guide' to discover this amazing city.

This is the perfect city loft experience with access from a typical Melbourne lane. Very well situated, with a unique caracter and soul, spacious and peaceful. You wish this was your home!

Many thanks Michelle.
It's a very great stay at Le City apartment. It's very easy to communicate with the host. Our whole family like this apartment so much. It's feel so warm and cosy.
Julia was great in communicating with us. The apartment is very convenient with public transport, a small supermarket and cafed and restaurants close by. Also great to able to book for 1 night.
Awesome place to stay, have a great time, plenty of space for 4 females too, would definitely recommend and stay again. Thank you....

Gresilda’s place was as a relaxing place.  Her home was very clean, tidy and tastefully furnished. I'd highly recommend it for families, couples or business travelers due to its relative proximity to Tullamarine airport.
Allan was an amazing host , nothing was to much trouble for him,  and they were very hospitable. All our needs were meet 100%. Cant wait to stay again was over all fantastic .
Nicole's place was great! Plenty of space, good location with easy access to public transit and across from the MCG. The check in process was easy and communication was a breeze. Highly recommended!
Brigitte's cottage is superb and the extra treats such as scones, cakes, truffles and fruit were delicious. Look forward to returning.
Amazing apartment which was beautifully decorated. The location was extremely convenient and the hosts were lovely! Would definitely recommend this place!!
The property is lovely and quiet, perfect if you like a bit of backyard wildlife. A small cottage as promised but enough space for two and great location. Looking forward to returning!

Lovely loft, great location near public transport and a nice pub and cafe. Cosy wee loft, slightly close to railway tracks but they are a distant pleasant rumble when they do sound. Beautiful aromas from the garden when walking in, and Denise was most hospitable. Great value!

The place was amazing. My family and I enjoyed it very much. I really do appreciate the electric blankets that was definitely a plus. I will definitely stay here again when my family visits in the future.

We had an amazing 3 nights at Klaudia and Jonathans place! The apartment is immaculate, its in a perfect location to see the sites of Melbourne and you really feel like you are in a jungle! We loved it :) and we definitely Recommend this place to stay if you're traveling to Melbourne! Thank you for having us

Yolande is a warm, friendly host and her lovely garden and comfortable attractive little cottage made our stay very easy and enjoyable. Beautiful healthy and fresh produce dor breakfast on the deck overlooking the garden and Netflix was an added bonus. Quiet safe and peaceful location walking distance to shops and the train.

WOW ! This place is in the heart of the action , Restaurants , Bars, walking to all places in the city and the best way to see and feel Melbourne.  The loft is lots of fun , larger than we expected , a great bathroom and of course the swing in the middle of the room ! The lane way has a great new coffee shop ,meeting place and literally metres away is several great restaurants and coffee houses. Across the road is the GPO building and transport was easy. Don't get stuck in a bland hotel , stay in the heart and soul ,stay in this Loft apartment !!

my stay at Allen's home was wonderful, very warm and cosy both in Allan's kindness and the surounds of the space. The garden was so sweet, the bed was comfy and the space was spotlessly clean, much appreciated. loved it.

This actually is my first time using airbnb and my friend and I are so lucky to meet Simon. The house is amazing, the host is nice, everything here are fantastic enough for us. This place is not very far from the city and it's the best choice for one or two families with a car. Anyway we are so happy with this experience. Thanks Simon!

An absolutely magical stay - the kind of place you wouldn’t be surprised to find fairies playing in the garden.
Beautiful hosts!

A great place for one or two people. Close to trains and trams in a quiet and pretty area. Denise was very helpful and friendly, with lots of advice re public transport, shopping etc. There’s a set of spiral stairs up to the loft but they’re well lit with automatic lights. I’d stay again for sure!
I booked this place for my husband.  He spoke highly of his experience and he is very fussy and hard to please!
A perfect place to stay if you want to access the MCG, AAMI park or the city.

Stylish space in great location. Nice towels and bed linen. Great location with beautiful leafy outlook, a lovely place to retreat to from cool Fitzroy. Cafes, bars and shops very close. Lots of lovely touches like the travel cards. The place was spotlessly clean and prettier than it looks in the photos. Everything was easy and I really appreciated the healthy snacks and breakfast options. ( plus the pod coffee) All in all a fabulous stay, I've found my new spot in Melbourne!
Great place as pictured clean great location near cafes, convenience store, secure apartment they even looked after our bags for us . I would recommend

This apartment in South Yarra is located perfectly not only for visitors to Melbourne Park for the Australian Open but also if you want to explore the Botanical Gardens and surrounds. It is very close to the city but it also provides very nice green surroundings to enjoy a stay in Melbourne. We enjoyed our early morning walks. The cafes and restaurants close at hand means you don't need to venture far to enjoy a good coffee, yummy patisseries and delicious meals, saving on transport costs. The air conditioning was a huge welcome in the summer heat.
Locating the actual apartment in the block wasn't straightforward, but we worked it out.

Great place in a great location...
Michelle is extremely knowledgeable of the area and helpful with whatever you may need.

Second time here and still absolutely charmed by this space. Beautiful in summer and beautiful in winter. I recommend this little spot to anyone who’s thinking of getting away from the city and having a little peace and quiet. You’ll feel super refreshed and recharged with the lush trees surrounding this cute house and please just get in that bath and come out feeling like a brand new person!!
