I had a lovely two weeks at Claire & Allan’s place. They’re very nice, like to share with host and taking time with them. Nice house, quiet, surrounded by a nice garden. Nor far from Melbourne center with tram or train. Very convenient ! I recommend it.

This was a fantastic stay. The house was perfect with massive soft towels, large rooms, the best shower I've had in ages and just a really homely, comfortable feel. Although the weather wasn't entirely in our favour there is a great outdoor area with BBQ and the option to dine inside or out. Central heating and cooling and all the mod cons of a modern home with a real country feel. Thanks Vikki.
We stayed at Lisa's place for seven days and found that it had everything we needed, and even more. It was very comfortable and convenient.

Comfortable room in Seaford. It was very private, which was what I needed as I was in town for work. Very clean and close to shops and beach. If you’re a light sleeper though, I do recommend earplugs as the train station is close by and quite loud. Thanks for a great stay!
Rose ‘s place is wonderfull  for weekend escapes. The price is reasonable with warm and friendly service.

This was our first Air BnB experience and we were glad we got Michelle as our host. The location was amazing - walking distance to the great cafes, restaurants and shops, but the actual space of the apartment was what was outstanding, so different and unique. The skyline from the huge windows had a really beautiful view. What you see in the pictures is exactly what you get. We would return again if ever in Melbourne and would recommend this to anyone. Don't think twice :)
PS: The swing adds a really interesting touch to the feel of the apartment!
If I had to have one critique - that would be that the bed was too soft - I perfer a harder bed, but that's just me.
Overall - well worth the money......
This property is absolutely beautiful! We loved our stay and if we had an event in the South Yarra again would definitely not hesitate to stay here

We loved Wendy's apartment - it is indeed superb and the views over the water, particularly at sunset, are incredible. It is a wonderfully situated apartment, across the road from the beach, within easy walking distance from shops and restaurants and a tram stop outside the door for those wishing to travel further afield. We four adults enjoyed the attention to detail in this light, airy and roomy apartment and were very comfortable and content during our six night stay.
We highly recommend this apartment.

We were so comfortable in this lovely
home and neighborhood.
Besides our private bathroom and bedroom,
we were given access to the kitchen, living
room, laundry, and outdoor patios.
Magda was very thoughtful and gracious.
We completely enjoyed our time there, and
now miss her and her sweet poodle Ike!

We have stayed in many Air bnb & we would have to say it was the best experiences. From the first messages of hi & welcome, the personalised notes on our arrival, to the final photo of us in the air, you made us feel ever so welcome. You can definitely tell this little gem you have created is your baby. You thought of everything anyone could want  on a night away from home. The place felt clean, fresh & very well appointed. You should be extremely proud of what you can offer others with your slice of heaven up in the hill. We would love to return one day, not only for the peaceful getway but also to see you again. THANK YOU from the bottom our hearts.
Great 2 bedroom apartment in a fantastic location. Everything you need is within minutes of the apartment.

We had a great stay at Marcs place in St. Kilda. The flat is only 5 minutes walk to the beach and 2 minutes to the tram. A perfect accomodation for some nice days in Melbourne.
Marc and Jenna are great hosts - very helpful, generous and friendly. Everything was clean and tidy and the bedroom quite comfortable. On our last evening we even had a barebecue on the balcony.
We had a really easy and relaxing stay and would recommend it to anyone.
Great place to stay, easy access to the city, clean tidy, fantastic views, couldn't have asked for more.
Great location, amazing view, lovely touches, so clean and tidy. We enjoyed our stay even though it was brief we will defiantly stay again when we are in Melbourne.

The apartment was very clean and had everything you wanted and more. Lots of bright light shining through the apartment which made the place inviting. Location is great with being right in the city. Plenty of transport around , trams, trains and most things are walking distance. The sofa bed came in handy with the kids. Would stay here again.
Katies place was just what we needed during our stay in Melbourne. It was spacious well equipped  private quiet and easily accessible. Good value too.
The place is exactly as described. Perfect spot to stay, close to the airport. Would definitely stay again

Karen and Michael have a delightful little independent cottage located on their Chum Creek  property. It is well appointed at a reasonable price. We were greated by Karen on our arrival and given a hardy farewell on our departure by Michael and the local kangaroos! Effortless experience. Excellent communication. Highly recommended.

Samuel is very kind and friendly. His house is big, quiet, and very clean everywhere in the house. Big kitchen open to use. They even provided free space in the fridge and cabinet in the kitchen for guests to use. Free parking off street. Wifi is good. We will stay in Samuel's house again when we will be around.
Cozy place with comfy bed. Great location nearby many shops and cafes. 3 min walk to the tram stop that takes you the CBD so very convenient.
The cabin and property were absolutely stunning and Jules truly is a ‘Super Host’! We had an awesome week at the wineries and can’t wait to come back again soon!

We stayed four nights in Melbourne and absolutely loved the unit! Great location! Two great cafes downstairs for breakfast and lunch. The unit is modern and nicely furnished. Loved having a sauna and a pool! Can highly recommend this place!

Stay here and enjoy eclectic, stylish, comfortable loft living and see Melbourne and surrounding areas. Enjoy the Richmond restaurants and cafes, drive the Great Ocean Road, visit Phillip Island,  see the penguins, see an Aussie Rules Footy game at the MBC, have a fine luncheon on the puffing billy Railroad, we were fortunate to be personally welcomed by two delightful people to their Richmond home, lovely people who made us welcome, helped us with dining (we loved the restaurants) love and gratitude to Kerrie and Robert xo

Allans studio isbeautifullly set up and he is a delightful host, adding a welcome package that made us feel very welcome and well taken care of. We also had a car and there was good safe parking on the street. We needed a place with access to the city and Dandenong and this was perfect. I would definately recommend hte studio and Allan to anyone looking for a long or shorter stay around Melbourne.

Yong's apartment not only offers an exceptional view, but offers everything that is to expected in a luxury room from cleanliness to pantry necessities. Check-in was simple and and navigating around the area was easy. Exceptional airbnb, definitely recommended!

Denise was a great host. She was there on arrival with a key and showed me through the space. It was clean and very cute. Accurate to the pictures posted. It's in a great area, close to shops and pubs and walking distance to North Fitzroy area. You also have a private entrance with own key and it's tucked away behind the main house with a little outdoor shared space. I highly recommend staying here. Can't beat the price either!!
Adam’s apartment is a compact and efficient unit in a great location. Extremely quiet and clean, we’d be happy to stay again anytime.

Kats place was delightful - with a lovely view of a private garden. The aprtment is North facing so it has lovely winter sun beaming in. It is very close to No.96 tram stop and across the road fromt the lovely Carlton Gardens
This place is really splendid and welcoming, close to things that matter but far away enough for some.peace! The addition of small things such as shampoo and spices were surprising.

Wow what an incredible stay! Katherine is the perfect host and left us lovely treats, eggs and milk for breakfast and even a hand written note! The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we could possibly want and the bed was soo comfortable. Photos don't do the tiny house justice - it is a gorgeous, bright, airy spot with amazing views from every window. Very private and so peaceful and relaxing - our only regret was having plans for the night we stayed - as we both agreed we would have much rather stayed and watched the sunset from the amazing deck! Thank you Katherine for a great weekend away!

Eva's place is beautiful. Clean and emaculately tidy. Lovely and cosy for a quiet night in with friends. Everything we needed was in the house. The beds were very comfy and it was great getting up to all we needed for breakfast and preparing it in the gorgeous kitchen. Eva is quick to respond to messages and check in and out was easy. The house is in the perfect location, slightly suburban but close to everything.

My family and I had a fantastic time here. The accommodation was comfortable and clean. It was closely located to a shopping centre, public transport and wasn't far from the city.
The host was very quick with her responses and very helpful.
Would definitely recommend.

My partner and I really enjoyed our weekend away at Little Yarra Tiny House. The perfect place to get away from the hustle and bustle of Melbourne and only an hour away. Secluded and private, the property boasts beautiful views and only a short drive into some beautiful towns. It rained the whole night our first stay and the sound on the tin roof in the mezzanine bedroom was gorgeous. We loved the personal touches ie. fresh eggs, flowers and blood oranges. Bright, airy and clean - Oh and the shower was fab too - hot continuous water! Thanks again Katherine
Jess & Luke
Mystical, semi-rural accommodation in the hills amongst genuine, hospitable mountain people. Recommended for families and those looking to get away from the banalities of every day life.
We stayed 3 nights at Paul’s place. It was amazing ! Really clean, beautiful view, nice pool and gym. We kept in touch with Paul by message and he was such a delightful host! Highly recommend !

A very cute little cabin in a rainforest setting. The accomodation was clean & easy to find following the instructions. It stayed surprisingly warm overnight and we didn’t need to use the wood heater. The hosts kindly let us bring our dog which was great for us. It was a shame it rained most of our time there but we still managed to get out for a walk in the rainforest. The one downside we found was the mattress on the bed quite was thin and could feel the wood of the bed through it.

Great stay! Unfortunately we could only stay 1 night but I’m glad we did. We were greeted as we pulled up and were shown around the rental. We went to the nearby RSL (as recommended) for a great dinner, walked along the beach and got ice cream down the road. Was truly a great night. DVDs available for us to watch at night and cereal and coffee provided for breakfast! Even got us soy milk as requested which was much appreciated. Thanks guys!

We weren’t expecting such a stylish and comfortable place.
Quiet neighbourhood and close to the city, shops and transport.
Definitely stay here if you’re visiting Melbourne.
Lovely clean modern accomodation, very comfortable bed, nice welcome treats and a spectacular view! Brigitte and John were great hosts, and we would happily recommend the Cherry Orchard Cabin.

Thank you Marc and Jana for making me feel welcome in your home. It was exceptionally clean and neat. The area is beautiful with many small shops and restaurants close by and of course the ocean across the road.
Greatly recommend the place. Good location. Lovely little townhouse with all amenities. Maja is also very nice host and gives very clear instructions. Definitely 5 ⭐️

The place is just like the pictures, amazing and unique. Love the greenery everywhere!! Also the location is awesome. Huge shopping center and tons of places to eat right downstairs. A must stay, if just to see the place in 4D.
Lisa was so easy to talk to and organise our stay with. The unit was very clean and had everything we needed.

Warwick is a kind, welcoming and fun host with a beautiful home. He stayed up until well past midnight to make sure I arrived safely after my flight was delayed from Sydney.
He is passionate about a wide variety of topics and is easy to get along with. Having said that, he is also one to respect your privacy.
I can highly recommend staying here. Plus Griff is a cutie and doesn't mind a cuddle or two! :)

We stayed at Deb's place and it was really good. Very central to all of the great South Melbourne spots like the market and Bridport Street. Easy to get a park nearby, check-in was a breeze. Narrow spiral stairs were the only tricky thing about the place! Overall a great stay.

If the Aspendale location (approx 15 min walk to the closest train station) works for you, I don't think it gets better than this! Breathtaking view, super nice host, all the amenities I needed, comfortable bed. The studio even seemed larger in real life than in the photos.  Mordialloc (where the closest train station is located) has supermarkets and a range of nice restaurants and cafes. If the need ever comes, I will definitely book the place again!!
A fabulous apartment - and such an amazing location in Degraves Lane.  If you want to be right in the city action - which we did - it is perfect.

There really aren’t enough superlatives to describe my stay at Pete’s. Although we never met in person he was charming, attentive, responsive, a great host. The apartment is in a great location accessible to CBD and surrounding neighborhoods. Breakfast across the street at Archie’s or Gabriel’s is a must. This was one of my top Airbnb experiences. If you want to something special take a day trip down the Mornington Peninsula. Hire a car and driver and see wineries, the amazing sculpture park at Pt Leo, pick strawberries, hot springs.... Its a fantastic day. It’s reasonable and customized to what you want to do. George was our guide and Driver
‭+61 468 929 013‬.
Pete and Pete’s Place Great!

Nicole's apartment was perfectly positioned for sports lovers wishing to attend events at the MCG. It is virtually right across the road from the stadium and has easy access to trams and trains. Our family of four found the apartment to be cosy and well equipped. The bi-fold windows in the lounge open to a gorgeous view and let in an abundance of light. There is a Seven 11 nearby, as well restaurants for those who don't wish to cook. Has all the mod cons of a hotel, with a bit more character!

Great little apartment in perfect location. Super responsive host with some nice personal touches. Was just what we needed and would definitely stay again.
Euan & Daniela

I was in town to watch the Australian open and Suzi’s location was very convenient to get to the venue. Suzi was very responsive prior to checkin and was very friendly when I met her in person. The apartment has great natural light and is a great space. Would definitely recommend

The cottage has a tasteful decor, super clean and tidy, generous treat from local produce to very delicious homemade sweets and cake.
Brigitte seems like a person who enjoys fine things and loves sharing it too.
We were at the cottage when the cherry season ended so we could walk around the farm to soak up morning sun or sit outside at sunset with mountain view in the foreground.
Brigitte and her friendly family are very responsive to your request to make our stay as pleasant as possible.
Thank you again for making our stay a memorable one.
Wonderful clean studio, in a beautiful location. Weather was warm during our stay but the fan did well to cool it at night for sleeping.

Lovely place, vera beautiful tree filled and green area, a perfect place to calm down, relax, enjoy  the awesome creation around. Olinda is a pretty  quiet little village whrer you find everything you need for daily  living, some nice cafes around - esp. the Ranges, very good fihn chips at the Fish cafe. Greater supermarkets ins Monbulk. Robyns and Ken#s house is a lovely place, they are very kind and considered guests and made sure that I felt at home, offering pick up at my arrival in Olinda and on my way back Barbare even took me down to the next train station. Everything is available that you might need for cooking, just bare in mind that a kitchenette does not replace a  fully equipped kitchen. You do have one hot plate, a microwave and a ricecooker to your disposal.
Great location. Easy to get to the city centre. Host was helpful with any issues. Kitchen was well kept and breakfast and foods were readily available for us in the morning to be cooked ourselves.

Nothing less than perfect. Lovely Host and beautiful place with much comfort. Highly recommend!!
Thank you very much

Zoe and Dan sorted out our post-lockdown blues, with their gorgeous cottage amidst a tranquil setting.The cosy fireplace by night, and fresh coffee enjoyed in the garden by morning, were exactly what the doctor ordered. This is the perfect location for a  weekend recharge!

Such a sweet little place like this hardly seems imaginable that it’s only 2.4 m x 5 m in size. A bit like Doctor Who’s tardis it seems a lot bigger on the inside! Psychologically it seems like your whole world is conveniently on hand when it’s own little kitchen bathroom study and bedroom.
Prior to arriving we were A bit worried because the forecast for the weekend was very hot with high 30s predicted but the little cabin is quite cool. In more ways than one! We used the fan to cool the place down overnight and then during the day keep the doors shut and it was fine. Sam and April suggested some great spots by the river to cool off and were great hosts.
We will definitely come back again
when we arrive at this apartment it was as described , we were not disappointed everything we needed for a comfortable stay "great week we will return
Absolutely value for money, a great location and incredible host. A little loud at times but nothing you aren’t used to within a day.

We really enjoyed staying in Ren Han's apartment. This is great location with amazing views and very useful. It is stylish and immaculately clean with a great bathroom and all the amenities you might need. 5 star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Grace has been a great host. The accomodation was perfect with all of the facilities needed for a long vacation.
The Moubray/Saint Kilda Tram Stop is located just across the road from the building providing easy access into central Melbourne.
We had two minor issues with the apartment which were resolved promptly.
Gorgeous and fun play to stay with thoughtful touches and a cosy, dreamy bed. Loved this one so much.
Lovely little room and fantastic location! The beach is a short walk as well as shops and restaurants. Was a great break from the city and Shaun and Nuan were awesome hosts ☺️

Shane was an excellent host, flexible with check in and check out times, and very friendly and welcoming. His recommendation for the nearby Beach Cafe was greatly appreciated, and I'd highly recommend stopping by if you're looking for brunch with a view!

The room itself was exceptionally clean and well presented. The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and the room was warm and cosy thanks to a great heater.

Our expectations were definitely exceeded, and I would not hesitate to stay here again.

This is a lovely rustic country house with comfy couches and beds. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook a roast, pasta, etc. The view is beautiful and driving through the area is lovely. Note that for heat in the loungeroom you need to start the fire each night, which we enjoyed doing.

Unbeleivable view from the apartment over the city and out to the harbour and ocean. Location was perfect for everything we wanted. Delicious Vietnamese restaurant downstairs which is perfect for familes. Outlet shopping across the road and Art Gallery and Theatres a short Uber ride away. Would definitely recommend.

A quaint little studio apartment in an excellent position with cute little touches added to make it feel just like home. Shane & Nuan were so accomodating and their place is a delight. Highly recommended should you be looking in the area.

Julie’s place was gorgeous and cosy and her communication made everything very easy. The cabin is in a great location, so close to Healesville but in a beautiful bushy, quiet area. The perfect place to unwind for the weekend.
We love Studio 3054. It's the third time we've stayed. It's a great space, great location, friendly hosts. Everything we need in Melbourne.

Kim is a great host, she made the access to the apartment very easy and even assisted us with our late arrival. The apartment clean and well appointed. It has a great location in the heart of the CBD, it is just right next to Swanston Street where all the restaurants are. The apartment is cosy and a right size for a family of 3. Moreover, there is free internet too!
My experience is good. Host replies quickly and is accommodating. Location is great for shopping trips. View is wonderful.
Amazing views, very clean and had the all the necessities. Had an issue with the key not working but it was resolved.
Mark is very generous and accommodating. Instant response for any queries or problem. He is a really reliable household that you can count on.
Maja was a great host and was super flexible with checking in and out. The house is very stylish and was perfect for our weekend away.

Had a great time at Kash’s place. Beautiful garden view from the balcony and plenty of sunlight. Location is perfect -Skybus, Coles and free trams are just nearby. Kash is responsive and friendly throughout our stay ( thank you).
Stayed at Shane and Nuan a few times now and its always been great! This time I drove 1.5hrs out of my way just to stay here again. Highly recommended!!

We had a fantastic time with the property being clean and big enough for a family of five and being in Melbourne for a basketball tournament, the location was perfect with not too much distance between stadiums. We definitely look forward to staying here in the future.

Everything was just great.
Shane and Nuan were helpful and thoughtful.
Very comfortable and cosy, location was very convenient for our purpose. Sensible value for money.

A great place, good value and in a great location!!!
Samuel was a fantastic host, the apartment was comfy and had all the creature comforts you need.
Highly recommended, would stay again for sure!

We had a great weekend at Brigitte's cabin, it is in a stunning location with beautiful views and easy access by car to many Yarra Valley attractions. Brigitte made us feel like part of the family with her welcoming presence. The little goodies she made were delicious and we greatly appreciated all the thought she put in to making our stay stellar.
Nick was amazing made very easy transition on checking in and out very kind and organised host , we will definitely be back

Lyndall’s place is gorgeous, I highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a Brunswick pad. It’s small, bright and cosy, immaculate and full of sweet touches. We felt very welcome. I hope to be back.

My husband, 6yo son, small dog and myself stayed at Siobhan’s place for a week before our recent interstate move.
The apartment is cute and cosy with everything you could need included. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the apartment was so quiet which meant for amazing sleeps for everyone. The location is super handy to all the local amenities, and we really felt at home.
I could have easily stayed longer and probably will when we’re back in Melbourne for holidays.
Siobhan was a great host. We really didn’t need her for anything during our stay as we are locals, but whenever I did have a question she was always quick to respond.

Apartment is bigger than I expected and in a fantastic location. The beach is a short walk away and very close to the train station into the city. We stayed with our toddler and two cats and had a great stay. Also super handy having a secure car park available. Apartment is clean throughout. 10/10 would stay again

Accurate information in the listing for the property and amenities available. Ideally placed for access to trains to Melbourne city Centre (5 mins walk to station) and hospital. Very clean and host very welcoming.

Zoe and Danny’s place Tuena was fantastic.
It was as described but better, it is quiet and private, it has a great rustic feel and look.
The candles and open fire make it very cosy.
We can highly recommend visiting Coldstream brewery the food was fantastic.

Our stay at the Tiny House was great! Being surrounded by the forest, donkeys and cows was so peaceful but the location is still close to shops, cafes, wineries and activities. Spacious & cosy, would definitely recommend :)

Great communication, and amazing place. Such a cool building, and an unbelievable location.
Michelle was accomodating of everything we needed, and I can’t speak highly enough of her.

Absolutely loved this place. Great space, great location and a fabulous Melbourne inner city vibe. Especially loved that it had a very big dining space and table. Easy check in and out. Parking on  the street right outside was very handy (parking permit provided by hosts)  Very highly recommend.

We stayed at Paul & Dans place this weekend and all I have to say is nothing but positive things , communication was fast and also easy to access the apartment was clean and also accommodating to our last minute request to stay thank you and I will definitely be booking again in the future!

Wonderful to stay with Shane and Nuan once again.  This is a great location for my visits to the area and I feel very at home and cared for as a guest.  The room is fantastic with everything you need and a very comfy bed.  Looking forward to when I stay again.  Booking and communication is first class and easy.

Brigitte and John were wonderful hosts and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Our kids booked in a one night stay here for us and Brigitte made lovely scones and a heart-shaped cake especially personalised for our anniversary.
The views and surroundings are beautiful at the cabin and you are surrounded by nature and native animals.
The space is clean and well maintained and we loved all the personalised touches.

Thank you to our host. The place truly is a great little bolt hole to experience inner city living in Melbourne. Transport, bike tracks, park lands, cafes, bars, galleries, shopping and the CBD are all so close. The style and amenity set up in the studio, especially the audio visual equipment is an added bonus. I real hidden gem. We hope to come and stay again.

We had a really lovely stay at the Cherry Orchard cabin located on the Cherry Boys farm and would recommend it for a quiet, country stay. The beautiful views from the front windows are rolling hills, the location is peaceful and picturesque. The cabin is very well equipt, had everything we needed and more, good heating, comfy beds, and lovely toiletries.
Hosts, Brigitte and Jon were very friendly and welcoming, the cabin was spotless when we arrived, and they even left us a range of home baked treats and fresh produce!
This accommodation is more than I expected.
Thanks Brigitte and Jon, I’ve no doubt we’ll be back!
Such a nice and tidy place, and walking distance to many places to eat and drink. Would definitely recommend and stay again for a night away
Gorgeous house, close to town, thoughtful touches. Really cozy and great for my young family.
Brigitte and John are wonderful! The property is surrounded by breathtaking hills and the rooms are beautifully set up so touchingly. We will be definitely coming back.
Great location and very responsive hosts. The place is perfect for couples wanting to stay at the city. Very convenient for public transport, also a few dining places and a supermarket nearby!

There is a reason that Brigitte and John have such stellar reviews for their cabin! It was everything you could possibly hope for and then some - a truely gorgeous location, surrounded by great places to eat and visit, two of the most kind and genuine hosts I've had the pleasure of meeting and even a few kangaroos hopping away in the background. We had a wonderful time there and begun planning our next visit before we even left. A truely special place!

Wonderful place! Everything was neat and clean. Would love to stay there again in our next trip.
Though to remember apartment is on 3rd floor but no lift.

Just the perfect tiny house. Amazing amenities, beautiful landscape and the comfiest little home you could hope for. We had a wonderful time and appreciated all the little touches April and Sam have put into the space. The hosts are super accommodating. Thanks again April, Aethel and Sam!

The pool is definitely the highlight of this place. The room is neat and the beds were very very comfortable. The shower looked fancy and had a 10 minute limit every 2 hours. But since there’s no aircon in the studio, it got quite warm and stuffy even with the two fans on. There was also limited utensils and we had to go buy some soap and sponges to clean them. We were happy to do that though, and the hosts seemed nice :)
Great place, amazing view and walking distance to anything in the CBD. Check in experience was extremely easy. Could not fault it, would book again :)

Amazing host, super quick to respond and went above and beyond for us as we were stressing to find somewhere to stay. Absolutely gorgeous location. Would 110% stay here again. Honestly one of the best places we have stayed at.

We loved our stay in this apartment - it is sparkling clean and a great size. So close to transport and restaurants and the view of the Melbourne skyline is a gorgeous bonus. Great value for money - we were sorry to leave!

Rob and Libby were very welcoming. The cottage is set in a beautiful part of the Dandenongs and when I woke up I was in another world. My hosts cooked me a dinner of organic chicken and breakfast with fresh orange juice was particularly welcome. They encouraged me to use the many walking trails in the vicinity to make the most of the location.

The accommodation was fresh, clean, spacious and very comfortable with its own ensuite attached.

This was our third stay with Marc and Anna and our second in The Chapel. It’s a lovely place to stay - light, airy and very comfortable. It has a lovely big bathroom. Perfect for couples.
Marc and Anna are great hosts.
The gardens are delightful.

A well equipped, clean apartment with a great view and in a good location for exploring town and the South Bank. Close to transport. Traffic and construction noise during our stay made sleeping a tad hard so earplugs and eye shades are a good idea.
Perfect location near transport and supermarket. Surrounded by beautiful parks. Bedroom is on the street-side so it can be noisy sometimes. It wasn't a problem for me.
This is a fantastic apartment and we really enjoyed our stay - Brian was really helpful with our reservation changes.

Shane and Nuan's place was fantastic - great location within a short walk of the beach and short drive of most spots we were keen to visit. It was clean and well equipped. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

I have stayed at Mark's property on multiple occasions.
The place is clean, has updated appliances, and the bed is extremely comfortable.
The bathroom is always well stocked and its hard to resist the mentos bowl in the hallway.
Thanks Mark

Excellent location in Melbourne with a range of cafes, bars and restaurants to choose from. The apartment was clean, comfortable and perfect for a weekend away. Check in was smooth and Sarah was very easy to get in touch with.
My first stay was great that I returned a second. Super clean, comfy and an exceptional host Brigitte!
Great place and totally as advertised. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would certainly choose to stay here again. Thanks Shannon and Angela!

This cottage is stunning.  The photos don’t do justice to this gorgeous home away from home.  It has everything you could ever need and a beautiful private lush garden.  Vikki provided us with lots of little extras that made us feel so warmly loved and welcomed.    Every room was bliss to be in.  Everything was in easy walking distance and it was the perfect stay while we attended an important family wedding.  Thank you Vikki for the opportunity to stay at your magnificent home

We loved our stay at the White Room, it’s an experience in itself. The space is expertly styled, cosy, comfortable and private.
The location is fantastic with trams close by and many great little wine bars, pubs and outdoor dining areas within walking distance.
We really appreciated your recommendations and worked through quite a number on your list.

Nice unit in lovely location with a view. Comfortable beds and general facilities.  Kitchen is tired with door falling off, cupboard,  and only 1 functioning gas burner and a dishwasher that doesn’t seal and leaks on the floor.  However still enjoyed our stay and what you see is what you get.  Bonus with 2 car parks also.
Lovely, tidy and clean. Very comfy bed and great location, just next to a train station and tram stop. Quiet except for the occasional train sounds
What a great family home to stay in. Would recommend it to any family coming for a holiday or visit. Thank you Grace!
Fantastic location, very spacious and clean apartment. Great communication and directions prior to stay. Will definitely re book!
The house is very stylish & clean, close to Flemington Racecourse, near trams, a great place to stay.

We spent such a lovely time in Seaford in this very cosy room! Everything was lovely prepared, it was very clean and tidy and very practical (microwaven, cattle, plates, fridge, things for breakfast, ...)!!
Shane and his family are VERY friendly and kind! THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING!!
Janine and Regula

Claire's place is in a great location close to the top of Sydney Road and trains/trams. The room is very nice with everything you need, and lots of extra little touches that make for a good stay. The house is a nice old villa with lots of character, and the outside back garden is a great place to relax. The hosts are very welcoming and friendly - a great place to stay.
Nicole was very responsive and provided lots of local information.  Tram and train directly outside and walking distance to many cafe's restaurants, wine shop etc so this is a very easy location.
The hosts are very friendly. The house is lovely, especially the garden! We'd love to stay here again and recommend this to our friends.
This place is amazing! What you see on the picture is all true. Location was perfect, rooms were artistically & thoughtfully put together. We loved every details of the home. I would stay here again.

Very comfortable and clean apartment.
Excellent location for cafes, shops , walked everywhere and there was visitor parking when our daughter drove to see us. Felt very secure .
Amazing place! Great location in Melbourne and view was  absolutely incredible. Clean and easy to collect keys and communicate. Would recommend :)

We enjoyed our stay at Nicky's place. She was very helpful as we only booked the day before we arrived. The space was clean and comfy and great that it was close to the city to suit our needs. We'd definitely stay again as it was good value too for 3 of us. Thanks for having us!
Just as the description, the apartment has enough appliances for you to cook and is pretty confy and well located.
Nice and sparkling house, right opposite to flinders st station. Tom is a great host and is very quick to respond.
Great value and location. Great amenities. Mark was helpful and speedy with responses. Would highly recommend!
We enjoyed our stay at the cottage. It was spacious and clean, light-filled, and had beautiful outdoor areas and views. Close enough to town while also feeling secluded.

This home is coming even more special than the photos show, it’s a truly wonderful home that feels warm, comfortable and incredible easy to spot yourself into. The location can’t be beat with great cafes 10-15 minutes walk in either direction and the beach a short walk too.
Our little family had the most wonderful time here and would highly recommend this home to anyone. Tara and Claire are great hosts, everything was very easy.

Simons place was a pleasure to stay in. It had everything we needed for the whole family. We even had an extended family Christmas Day there and everyone had a thoroughly great time. It's close to shops, public transport and in a lovely quiet street.

Our stay at Toorak Luxury was a highlight of our trip to Australia and gets top marks from us. Well-maintained, spacious, comfortable.
It is well described in the listing, our host was extremely accommodating and responsive and there is nothing I can fault the place on.
We loved the leafy streets, the pool, the place.... and were sad to move on.
Warmly recommended!

We booked this house for a large group of 18 people as it offered 10 bedrooms. It’s a lovely place although the garden is nothing to write home about. What we didn’t know at booking is that it’s 3 separate apartments with 3 separate entrances. Also 9 of the bedrooms are excellent but the double- bunk room is tiny and only suitable for children really, which was an embarrassment to us when we arrived.
Nevertheless it’s comfortable and appealing place to stay, especially the main house, and in a great location.

This apartment is in a fantastic location; the one issue we had was that the bed was quite difficult to sleep on and not as comfy as we would have liked; however, we really enjoyed our stay here and Nick was really helpful. Thank you so much for having us!
Katrina’s place was perfect in every way. The accommodation met all my expectations plus it was close to a wonderful breakfast and lunch spot.  I could not have asked for more!
Great hosts, location, apartment and great value! I would recommend and I will stay again. Thanks for a great stay.

Kat's studio is in a great location. Close to cafes and restaurants. it's clean and tidy with big full length glass windows leading to a small balcony sheltered by trees. I hope to make this my regular stop when I have to visit Melbourne for business.

Quaint townhouse in the best spot in Melbourne. Very close to lots of cafes, restaurants and boutique shopping. The apartment was clean and well equipped, and the water pressure in the shower was amazing. The only thing I’d note to future guests is that the double bed has both a head and end, so if you are tall (like my boyfriend is) you may find it a bit cramped. Overall a lovely stay.

This location of this place is awesome and check in is very simple/well described by the hosts. Unfortunately we encountered a few issues, including dirty linen, a broken dishwasher and toilet seat, and no microwave (though this is indicated as a provided amenity). The location is well worth it though!

Jana place was so far the best Airbnb place. I came to Melbourne for work and did not know about anything and didn’t have any friends so I rent Airbnb before renting real accommodation. I was not expect much to Airbnb but Jana’s place was a full of surprising. She helped me everything and share her meal, also she took me around her house,shopping and inspection apartment too:), she treated me as their family member. House inside was sparkling clean and very modern, they have very big nice kitchen also bathroom. They even let me use their parking spot too. Their family is also supported me in many situation and they are so sweet. The Airbnb is more than the value. You never feel lonely. So I recommend everyone but especially people don’t  know about Melbourne. I am still keep in touch with her and already miss Jana’s family! Definitely stay again if I have a chance :) thank you very much for your support and kindness Jana.

I booked for my parents stayed for 4 weeks and they loved the place. It is very neatly set up, with all utilities needed for living. The outside of the building seems a little worn down by the sea wind, but the inside is newly renovated and very comfortable. The best part is the stunning ocean view right from the bed and living area, and you will never be bored staying at this place as the ocean looks different all day long. The shopping centre is about 15 min walk, which you can get to via the beach. Lenna is a very friendly and helpful host. She responds to questions quickly and checks in via email from time to time. Would be happily stay again!

Mon she is perfect host ever. I really impressed she prepared multi-adapter for international people. I don't really need because I live in Australia by the way it was so useful for my family. House was very clean and cozy. I definitely stay again later.
Lisa’s place was very nice. Everything that she posted is accurate and I really enjoyed my time at her place :)
Super convenient location, loved going for a swim at the pools across the road! Place was super clean and cozy.

I loved my stay at Anne’s place - the apartment is beautiful and looks over her veggie garden, which she generously lets guests use herbs from. The neighbourhood is lovely, quiet and safe to walk around at night. Anne also goes above and beyond to make your stay comfortable - she provides a pantry of basic cooking supplies as well as delicious ingredients in the fridge for breakfast. Likewise, the bathroom is stocked with toiletries and basic medications and the bookshelf is full of interesting reads. A final bonus - great water pressure! When I next go to Melbourne I hope to stay here again :))

We absolutely loved this house and would highly recommend staying here. The house was beautiful and exceptionally clean. It had all the comforts of home. It was a beautiful property and very peaceful.
Helen’s place had everything you needed, cosy & clean, walking distance to shops, private entry and easy communication with Helen. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend her place to others.

Anne’s place is just lovely.The studio is well set up and homey while the garden warms your heart.Lovely space to sit and relax.Anne also has the kitchen and the fridge well equipped.Would highly recommend.

Yolande has created a very special place to stay.  It has everything to make a stay very memorable.  Well equipped and comfortable.  It's quiet with a delightful garden.  It's a little oasis with just the birds and bees to keep you company.  You will enjoy every moment. Highly recommended.

Fantastic Airbnb. Has everything you could possibly need, was very clean and the communication from Louise was wonderful, she’s very attentive and helpful. Check in is super easy and the apartment itself is lovely, exactly as described.
Walking distance to Albert park for the GP and a few different tram lines as well and directly above a cafe.
Would definitely stay here again!

Adam went out of his way to accommodate my partner and I on our trip to Melbourne. We felt so at home that we did not want to leave what we call our 'Love Loft'. It is perfect for performers who need to get away from the hustle and bustle of the world to prepare for auditions and or performances.

Marnie was such a sweetheart checking us in! We got there a little too early, but she said we could leave our luggage while we checked in. She even texted us to come back when she was done cleaning! Gwyneth’s place was super clean and the perfect location for us first timers in Melbourne. So many restaurants and shops were within walking distance. The building itself is pretty new and there was a security guard there at the front desk at all times (so we felt really safe). Lovely balcony and awesome views. For being in the city, it wasn’t loud at all so we got a good nights rest. I had trouble finding the living room light switch and texted Marnie. She texted back straight away and was super helpful (it’s behind the front door and wall between the gap). We would definitely come back and stay here again!

Lisa is a great host, who always gets back to you quickly. The flat is in a great spot and within a short walk to the train station and Sydney road. It is as advertised, basic but clean and has everything you would need when on holiday.  There is a small garden out the back with fantastic plants and a spot to sit and enjoy a red. It was hot whilst we were there and there is a new A/C which is great. Thanks Lisa !

Well presented little loft perfect for a couple and within about a 5 minute walk to nice cafes and restaurants in Prahran, 10 minute drive to the war memorial and botanical gardens and 5 minute walk to the train station with train taking around 15 minutes to the crown casino.
Adam was a warm and friendly host providing plenty of advice on places to eat and instructions to get the keys and access the loft were easy and quick.
There were plenty of options for parking on the street in front of the loft also.
Amazing location, beautiful apartment! The new decor is fab. Nicole was very helpful, I would definitely stay in this place again.
Location and cabin was beautiful, a few minor issues during our stay such as the oven and spa jets not working but if those were in working order would certainly recommend this little getaway

The host was very helpful and communicative, and the apartment had what we needed (except from a big mirror, there’s only a small one in the bathroom). However, the apartment’s location is right next to a big road, so be aware that it can be noisy.

Great little unit just opposite the park and beach, very close to the tram line, Luna Park and restaurants/bars in St Kilda.  Leanna was a great host who was very quick to respond to any requests. Great place to stay! Would come back again.

We stayed at Samuel's property for almost a week. Absolutely loved the place. Cosy, compact and super convenient. Very close to the shops, some great cafes nearby serving fantastic coffee and abundant food options. Easy walk to the train station and tram stop if you are travelling by public transport. The place itself was very clean with all amenities provided. The wifi facility and the office desk really helped for our work on a couple of days. Super comfortable beds in both the rooms. Good enough kitchen space to cook meals with sufficient cookware. Easy to access, sufficient parking space. Samuel was readily available for any questions we had during our stay with quick responses. We'd definitely recommend his place if you looking for homely comfort closer to the city.
Easy and fast check in. Location is great! Apartment was not that well cleaned though and not enough toilet rolls

Thanks Margaret for your amazing hospitality and the great choice of food that was prepared for us! It was very thoughtful. My husband and I enjoyed our stay very much, especially watching the views from your home during sunrise and sunset! The place was very comfortable and clean, and very close to the wineries we visited, thank you also for the great recommendations!

The Chapel was the most outstanding accommodation I have stayed in for a number of years.
The historic building was unique and interesting, situated in a quiet court. The apartment was beautifully fitted out with quality furnishings, comfortable fireside nook, great heating and every conceivable extra we needed. Lovely wide private verandah space looking out over well maintained gardens and lawn. Everything about the Chapel was relaxing and a pleasure to stay in.
I cannot recommend this accommodation enough and hope to return again.

We stayed at Sarah’s place for the best part of a week. It’s well located - close to theatres, shopping, groceries, good coffee, great restaurants and public transport. The apartment is tastefully decorated, bigger than it looks in the photos, and has a nice view of the city skyline. Sarah provided a dedicated workspace with a fast internet connection, more than enough to productively ‘work from home’ for the week. Sarah was warm and friendly and we felt welcome in her apartment. It’s a good corner of the city to stay in and we certainly hope to be back!

Mark's place is fabulous! Great location, really clean, the bed is super comfy too, lovely little touches like coffee and snacks when you arrive and he was always available for any questions or queries I had. 3 minute walk to the tram in to the city and 15 minute walk in to central St Kilda. Highly reccomend this place! :)

Fantastic location, great value little flat!
Leanna was extremely easy to communicate with.
I messed up my dates and she went above and beyond any expectation to accommodate me. Would happily stay again

-Brilliant views
-Close to activities and Main street
-Take up your DVD's as the ones there are limited
-Maybe bring some of your own cooking equipment and crockery as the ones provided are limited as well as cleaning equipment.
Brilliant apartment! Located perfectly for exploring the city. Trams are easy from there into the city. Grant was great for check in and communicating. Perfect for a Melbourne city visit!
In a great location, easy check in and great value for money. lovely cosy apartment would 100% recommend

Sarah is an exemplary host who was very accomodating to us during our stay at her place. Her responses were very fast and she even came over last minute when we were unable to get inside the airbnb right before our return flight. The bnb was clean and had all the essentials for a comfortable stay, including extra blankets and a hair straightener which was a great surprise. The location is extremely convenient and within walking distance to the main CBD area. Thank you Sarah for the most amazing experience! :)

My partner and I had booked for a 12 night stay. Within the first day we noticed the kitchen sink was broken and Netflix plus the normal channels on the TV weren't working. By day 5, the bathroom flooded unexpectedly which led us to an early check out ! I'm still waiting for my refund which is annoying 🙄
But besides that! the place was clean with an easy check in. Communication with the host was quick and easy with absolutely no issues. Location was perfect and close to everything you need.

Lovely place, very Melbourne. Great location,  definitely one of a kind! Amazing to find this secret of Melbourne - would absolutely recommend. Michelle also allowed us an early check in which was very much appreciated.

Great host was lucky enough to meet Kate in person. would highly recommend staying here if you dont mind having takeaway for a couple of nights I wouldn't have anything bad to say about the place or host great experience thank you

Anne's place is surrounded by a wonderful Australian native garden and offers
all the comforts of home.
Relax and unwind in this peaceful environment and be inspired by the beauty.

The Chapel was such a fantastic stay! Looks even better then the photos and has everything you need for a weekend away. Such a cosy stay on a cold autumn weekend, would absolutely stay again when in the area.
Fabulous experience staying with Antony. Worked with me to assist with early check in when needed. Fabulous communication. Would recommend

Great place for visiting inner city Melbourne but without the hassle of noise, parking, driving in the heart of the city. Great value and plenty of room for a one-bedder. Very well appointed and supplied with some extra goodies
Not a bad spot. Just be aware that the photos might not reflect the room you end up staying in

Absolutely fantastic stay; the place looks just like the photos and Klaudia, Jonathan, Maria & Tony are 10 stars for communication and provided just the best time. If you're looking for a unique rainforest and heaven retreat in the heart of the CBD stop searching - you've found it. Book now!

Zoe and Dan's place is so beautiful - perfect location, great fireplace and really comfortable beds. We had such a great time, and their communication and flexibility made it so much better.
We'd highly recommend Zoe and Dan's place to anyone!

Absolutely breathtaking views of the beach, and everything was just so prefect about this trip. 5 to 6 mins to restaurants and Woolworths 5 mins to seaford station. The best host ever! Showing me the best way to go around, telling me all the useful information. I absolutely recommend this house for everybody.

I cannot recommend Cath's place enough. We decided to spend a couple of days working here and absolutely loved it. The house was beautifully styled and spotless, having a desk was also incredibly convenient for work. The location is incredible and Cath was there to help us with any questions we had during our stay. Cannot recommend the place enough, I'll definitely be booking again.

Katie was a great host, offering easy communication and support when needed. Thank you!
The location of the apartment is excellent for those wanting to enjoy everything Collingwood has to offer.
Future guests should be aware that there are 2 very similar buildings located side by side and confusion between the 2 is possible late at night or after a glass of wine or 2! 😉

This place is a real gem situated in a beautiful neighbourhood within a walk of town. The place has been decorated with so much care, and we especially loved the lovely ambient lighting. It felt very special staying here, and it was a very cosy base to come back to in winter. Marc and Anna are super prompt with their communication.

One of Airbnbs that I had a wonderful stay. The view is a big plus especially when you cannot go out much during this time. I hope I could stay longer. The place is clean and I had everting I needed during my stay.

Neat little apartment in close proximity to the city. We were able to secure an Uber really quickly to get around and there’s public transport to get in and out of the city. A comfy bed and a quiet stay.
Louise also left us some breakfast items in case we wanted to cook up our own bacon and eggs, but there just happens to be a great little cafe less than 60 seconds from the front door that was too good to pass up.
Wonderful apartment in the heart of Melbourne's CBD. Great check-in. will definitelystay again.
Claire stay is a lovely spacious bedroom, well furnished with a comfortable bed. The unexpected breakfast was just what we were looking for and check in was a breeze. The garden is delightful!

Beds were extremely uncomfortable woke up with a sore back every morning. Apartment was not clean when we arrived with stains over the sheets and pieces of glass on the floor. Very small apartment. Kitchen utensils were dirty. Wouldn’t stay here again!!!
Only good thing was the location of the apartment.

From booking through to check out, Shannon and team have been really accommodating with various requests and have welcomed us into their apartment with everything we could need.
The apartment has been immaculate and homely with super comfortable beds!
We had to check in early and leave late due to changing timings during COVID and Shannon was very accommodating
All in all, a perfect stay - thank you!

Dahlia is very welcoming and we felt comfortable staying.   It was great to be able to open our door and know that our 2 small dogs were safe.    It is one room and an en suite, however, the room is quite large so we didn’t feel cramped.

We ran into some problems retrieving the keys at check in but Ming and his team responded swiftly. Apartment has a great view and had nice facilities. Woolsworth was just right at the door step - super convenient!
Wonderful accomodation! Very comfortable, amazing communciation and beautiful artwork! It was a very comfortable space!

What a beautiful place - I couldn't believe how nice it was, even better in real life than the photos. Michelle was a perfect host as well, very helpful and extremely easy to communicate with! Would 10/10 recommend and would love to stay again!

We loved our stay in Melbourne. The apartment was clean and plenty of room for my husband, my son and I. The apartment had everything we needed including a washing machine and dryer. The amenities, pool/gym were excellent.
The view from the apartment of an evening was amazing!
The apartment is close to the Southern Cross Station and is in the free tram zone, this made getting around the city very accessible.
If you prefer to walk it’s not too far to walk into the city from the apartment. There was a Coles right across the road which was also extremely convenient.
The communication by Alex was excellent.
I would stay here again and recommend the apartment to anyone wanting a getaway in the city of Melbourne.

Ting’s place was lovely and cosy for our weekend stay. It was very clean and we really appreciated the extra effort that was taken to make us feel at home. We travel to the area yearly and will definitely be staying again.

True to pictures, beautiful views in prime location central to Melbourne's shopping and entertainment district. Hosts were incredibly helpful and very quick to reply to messages. They even held our bags for us prior to check in time so we could get the most out of our first day. Would definitely stay here again.
Lovely home, true to its description. My friends and I stayed here for 4 nights and still could not get over the view!
We loved our stay. Plenty of space for two couples. Great peaceful location and an easy drive to many wineries in the Yarra Valley.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay- the location is perfect with just a 5 minute walk to the beach, trams on your doorstep and shops around the corner!
The flat was compact but was nice and cosy for the 3 of us.
Melissa was very welcoming and organised. There was a booklet which she'd left informing us of the best places to go in the area and any additional information we needed regarding appliances within the flat.
My friends and I stayed in the flat for just over and month. Overall it was a brilliant base for our Melbourne experience !

Great location, easy tram access to the city.... Was nice to be away from the hustle and bustle.
The unit we stayed in was very tired and dated and not what we really imagined from the pictures advertising, however bedding etc was clean.
Communication and check in/out was easy and pleasant! Great to have parking onsite for a small fee.
Was a really nice place - parking is easy to find outside the property. Very clean apartment with a modern bathroom.
Grant is a great host. The apartment was in an amazing location and made getting around incredibly easy. Highly recommend staying here.

A comfortable , well-lit apartment in an ideal location. So close to The Comedy Club, The Princess Theatre, and Her Majesty's Theatre. It was larger than we expected. Friendly host. Would happily stay here again.

What a wonderful place to stay! Private  clean and comfortable. I slept so well, the bed was just perfect. It was lovely to look out onto the garden each morning. Yolande treated me to some yummy homemade treats too, very spoilt! I will definitely come again.

Grants place is spectacular with stunning interiors. Grant is easy to communicate and he is very accommodative in terms of us not being able to get our key in time and he find the solution to our problem. The apartment is nice and clean with really good vibe. I think this is definitely a good weekend getaway kind of apartment for an individual or a couple.

Lynda's airbnb is in a central location and easy to walk to everything.  The styling is so interesting and I loved the special touches such as the teas, coffee, breakfast and the books and magazines.  The bed was super comfortable and the under floor heating is so perfect for a cold winter stay in Melbourne.

Sean was a simple and humble host and tended to everything we needed during our stay. He has a beautiful and cosy house which felt like home away from home. Great location as well, close to the trams and prime Fitzroy. Would definitely come back to stay if possible.

Amazing stay. Everything is exactly as it is on the airbnb page. Melissa is on the call and she does take good care of small details like a handmade book full of restaurant recommendations and toiletries. She was very flexible with check in and out, which is amazing for people travelling early or late. In general, it is a really nice cozy place.
The place was great - clean and cozy. Great location and is close to everything - beach, botanical garden, coffee shops and trams. Will definitely pick this again when I’m down here. Highly recommend
Lovely, comfortable place with a kind natured and very welcoming host. I felt completely looked after and would absolutely stay there again. 100% recommended.
Lovely place to stay. Host was very helpful and friendly. View from the place was amazing! Highly recommend it.

Building is a bit yucky but the apartment is great and a nice location right near the London Tavern. Excellent off street parking (and I have a big car) good heating, full kitchen. Tea and coffee provided but no milk. Would return for sure.

An amazing property for a girls getaway which was beautifully decorated, warm, cosy and also a fabulous location. We didn’t need to get in the car all weekend! The house was well equipped with everything we could possibly need and Shelly was a wonderful host. Highly recommend!

Great location, fantastic view - just as per the pictures, if not better!
Can tell it has been a well used AirBnb, but everything was as expected and has everything you need for a Melbourne city stay! Eduardo was also great with all communication and always replied very promptly.

The apartment is in a fantastic location, and is nice and tidy. Frank and Pam sent through easy to understand instructions and their communication was great. I would just suggest spending a little more time on the cleaning, especially in the bathroom as this was definitely in need of a deep clean.

Denise made me feel very welcome and I had a lovely stay.  The loft is a comfortable, welcoming, cosy space with great facilities. It is well situated on a lovely tree-lined street, close to public transport - 86 tram and Rushall train station - and cafes, bars and restaurants. I recommend it as a great place to stay and I'd love to stay again.
Small but nice accommodation. Great location close to Monash Uni. Quiet street and easy parking. Would stay again.

A fantastic place for our 25km Covid escape!  Full of surprising touches, and a very comfortable bed in a really welcoming, soothing room. Though it looks a bit wild in the photos it is really very homely. Lots of great books, fantastic bath, loved the sinks too! Sunny outside area a bonus too, and nearby beach and wetland walks full of interest.  Love to go back when we can go out sans mask and actually eat at a restaurant or go to the pub!
Fantastic stay - right where we wanted to be in the heart of North Melbourne - and great hosts. Super communicative and welcoming. Will definitely stay again.
Really enjoyed our stay with Alex, we were able to communicate with Alex at all times.  The view was excellent and was definitely the highlight of our stay.

A gorgeous escape, so close to Melbourne. Such a serene part of the world with incredible views. The cottage is everything you could want, so cosy and visually pleasing. The cottage was our destination, we just wanted a place to stop, relax and breathe - it was everything we hoped for. Amazing bird life and beautiful gardens to wander around. Even a hot air balloon above one morning! Can’t wait to go back. Thanks so much Zoe and Danny!
The house provides all the necessary amenities for a comfortable short stay. It is clean and very liveable with a large yard and perfectly positioned front porch for the afternoon sun.
A very cozy place nearby amazing landscape. The amenities are all you need for a weekend getaway. Definitely coming back and the host is very kind and gave us a warm welcome.
Excellent location and very good value. Layout and equipment was excellent.  The bed was the most comfortable I have slept in for a long time.

A little piece of heaven!
Completely private gorgeous unit with little hideaway kitchen and large modern bathroom. Super spacious and surrounded by beautiful trees and greenery. Stunning garden and lovely sun-drenched terrace.
The surrounding forests and villages are simply wonderful.
Hosts, Robyn and Ken, are lovely and happy to help out if you need anything.
Highly recommend!
I recommend this place to anyone staying in Melbourne. The apartment has Everything you need  and the location is fabulous. Plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby as is public transport.

Amazing location with free parking in the middle of the city. It's simple and cheap and you won't be spending anytime inside except to shower and sleep. You'll have the whole of Melbourne at your fingertips!

This is something special, if you're after a creative haven for that unforgettable experience. The owners have photographed it authentically, so there is no disappointment. The bedding is extremely comfortable and the location in Melbourne's CBD is 5*. Very clean. Very memorable. Excellent communication.
We did not feel welcomed but we did feel as if we were an inconvenience.   The cabin was good and the location great and convenient.
Very interesting house in a good location in Williamstown. Very clean with lots of amenities. Highly recommended.
Amazing place at an amazing location. The cottage is absolutely beautiful and worth every penny! We had abolutely no issues whatsoever,  we had everything we needed!
Great space for the kids and close to the beach. Beds were comfortable. Kitchen met all our needs and bathrooms were clean and well designed. The family enjoyed using both the bathtub and showers.
Great location, very clean and homely. Leanna was very accommodating and we would love to come back and stay again.

Wow what an amazing space and unique apartment right in the heart of the best the city has to offer. So central to top restaurants, great coffee, tucked away bars, and an easy walk to the Yarra too. Michelle was so helpful and accommodating. This warehouse space will take your breath away.
Thanks for a fabulous weekend.

This is a wonderful little cabin surrounded by gorgeous woods, little chickens and a smoochy ginger cat  running around. We had everything we needed in the cabin and there were lots of great things to do in Healesville and the surrounding areas. I’d recommend staying here!
We had a nice stay at Selina’s place, it’s just a few stops out of the free tram zone so with a short walk you won’t even have to get a myki if you’re planning on staying close to the cbd

Peter is truly an artist and I’m honored to have witnessed his art collections.
He’s a kind host and you will be rewarded with much more than what you have paid for.
Great location. Right by Queen Victoria market and mins by foot to city.
Highly recommend this!

Perfect in every way. The accommodation and host exceeded our expectations by far and would recommend to anyone visiting Melbourne as it is only a small drive or train commute to the city but has all the attributes of a quiet cottage getaway.

We thoroughly enjoyed our relaxing stay in this charming, well located and very comfortable cottage. Beautiful views from within and from the deck. Just a short stroll to the river walk and shops. We recommend this property if peace, nature and tranquility are your thing.
The view is quite different at different times of the day, so it was great to be on the balcony and looking out the windows, we really were in the treetops!
Clean and spacious apartment in a very central SY location. As long as you don’t mind a bit of road noise I would highly recommend.

This is an ideal place for a Melbourne visit. It is close to everything we wanted to see. Carpark was arranged in a separate building. It is modern and clean with a good view to the north.Highly recommended.

Fantastic location, close to Southern Cross station where you can catch a train or tram to almost anywhere else in Melbourne. And nearby is Spencer Outlet Centre where you can do some shopping and there’s a Coles too which opens late into the night.

Clean, comfortable and well situated. Great for a family of 3 or 2 couples. Warm, quiet and comfortable. We had a relaxing stay. Well appointed bathrooms. There's a few stairs so it's not for those with mobility issues, same goes for the bed. The bed base has a bookcase/shelf running around the sides that extends 10+cm beyond the mattress. Beware if you use the bathroom in the night!

The location is perfect, right in the middle of the city. There are plenty of restaurants and shop around. The unit is average, there are cockroaches but we manage by spraying with anti insect each time we go out. The communication with the host is very limited. She never answer reply to my message.
We had a great time, good location in the heart of Melbourne CBD.  Very neat apartment, well maintained. So generous and with lots of essentials that can be use during stay. 👍👍👍

My partner and I loved our stay at Louises apartment. The apartment was very clean comfortable to stay in and it’s in an amazing location! Will definitely be wanting to stay there again when we are in Melbourne next :)

This place is beautiful! The balcony is larger than it seems and has a nice view. The rooms are spacious and there are plenty of amenities in case you forget the essentials. The kitchen is also extremely clean and easy to use. Definitely recommend!

This beautiful cottage is full of charm and comforts. It’s set up on a hill and the views of rolling hills and mountains from the 2 decks are stunning! The home itself is wonderfully decorated and has all the amenities including a very large new TV. We enjoyed a cosy fireplace, and meals in the kitchen or verandah. Our only gripe is the bed is extremely firm so if you’re a sensitive sleeper like I am, it’s not the most comfortable sleep. But the location, views and peace and quiet made up for it. Shaun is a wonderful host. Would love to return someday!
Great weekend getaway for me, very quiet place while also being close to what you need and only a little away from the nice roads in the dandy’s.
An incredible home for a few nights stay in Melbourne. The beds were the most comfortable of any hotel or Airbnb that I have ever stayed in. Highly recommend.

I am a return guest for a reason. Yolande is a terrific host and the cottage has a great feel. I enjoy sitting on the porch with a view of the gardens. It's also a quick walk to the beach and cafes. I've stayed in many Airbnb's and this is  one of my favourites
If you’re looking a place to stay in Melbourne then this is it! Christine is great and the place is beautiful and cozy :)

Gresilda is the best host we have ever seen, kind, enthiusiastic, with quick response to any request. the housie is big and tidy with evrything we need tohave a relax and comfortabl stay. we will definitely come back in our next trip to melbourne.

Perfect location. Great to have such a large space. The apartment is not quite as nice as it seems from the photos - just a little bit tired. But on the whole a good experience - the location made up for any shortcomings!! Host was very responsive and helpful.
Lovely host.  Communication excellent.  Even bought over some food he had cooked for his family, which was lovely.

Nice destination, nearby supermarket, tram and train station.
Very clear to introduce the house by Nick. He is very nice.
location location location!!! It was a perfect spot, walking distance to everything required. Place was beautiful and we had a great stay

Stay Casa was amazing - views and more views. The place was sparkling clean, super stylish and had everything we needed. Communication with the host was outstanding.
Oh and did I say amazing views!!

The apartment is a great size with modern setup, sunset balcony views, aircon and comfy bed.
Great location near to trendy bars, shops and with a wonderful cafe beneath.

Super friendly and helpful hosts to begin with. Prompt response & the accommodation’s location and view is amazing. Had a really comfortable 10-days stay here and I’d totally recommend to anyone who is looking for somewhere that feels cozy and homey!
Beautiful place with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The highlight for us was the huge window in the living room! Louise is friendly and quick to respond.
lovely place to stay in Melbourne along the Southbank. the ability to use facilities like the gym, pool and spa were great aswell. would recommend

We stayed at Nicky’s place for our wedding weekend since it was so close to everything in St Kilda. It is a lovely spacious apartment, full of natural light and with everything you need. Nicky was a fantastic communicator and great host.

What to say!
Staying here was a dream, a perfect oasis and just want we needed.
It was warm and welcoming, the design and curation was inspiring.
We will be reminiscing about Jacky Winter Gardens for some time to come.
Thank you Jeremy and Lorelei, I am sure we will be back!

We had an excellent stay at Tom + Susanna's. The location is amazing and so close to mini supermarkets, restaurants and anything else you might need. It was quiet at night too so a very comfortable stay! Tom + Susanna were very prompt in replying to any issues I had - we will be looking to book again one day!

Renlei was responsive to our needs and provided clear directions on late check-in and car park booking.
The place itself is great. Bright, with cityscape view, and well equipped. Couldn’t have asked for something better.
The house is beautiful, spacious, well equipped, clean and in an ideal location. Michelle answered all of our enquiries promptly and was a wonderful host.  Would definitely stay here again!

The apartment is well situated for easy access to transport, cafes, shops and galleries. The apartment is well appointed and comfortable. The outside noises were quite intrusive in the early morning as major building works are going on nearby - for light sleepers we would recommend ear-plugs. Tom and Susanna are very approachable and obliging with any issues arising.
- Col and Merran

We had fantastic stay at the apartment! It is very cosy, stylish and sparkling clean. What’s more is the convenient location where everything from supermarket, restaurants and transportations are all within walking distance. Will definitely recommend anyone who’s visiting Melbourne to stay here.
Fantastic stylish space in a great location. Anthony and Cinthya are great hosts, very accommodating and easy to get in touch with. This was my second stay at their place, which I highly recommend.

Great apartment for a little getaway for 2. Location was excellent right in front of Southern cross station where the airport bus goes to and from. Also easy to walk around the cbd from there or take trams anywhere.
I didn’t hear from the host in the 8 days I was there but didn’t really need much as everything was pretty straight forward.
A bit disappointing that the pool was super cold but everything else in the apartment block was great, especially the uninterrupted views.
Great location and very helpful hosts. Unfortunately bathroom has mould and shower screen leaks a lot. Once that'sfixed it will bean excellentplace to stay.

Samuel's Air BnB is absolutely beautiful with everything you could possibly need. It truly feels like a home away from home with every detail being thought out. There was even a lovely set up for breakfast. I couldn't recommend Samuel's place enough

Nicole's place was perfect in every way. Super clean and comfortable apartment, beautiful view of the city, excellent location and a wonderful host who made sure that we didn't have to worry about a single thing while there.

The listing was accurate in every tiny detail, starting from acquiring the keys to the apartment, to accessing the parking spot under the building, to the various amenities within the place, to the super helpful list of places around the apartment that we could enjoy during our stay there.

I would highly recommend this listing to anyone who wants a super comfortable and headache free trip to Melbourne.

The place is perfect for a short stay in the City. Great local shops, bars and cafes, very close public transport and a quiet residential street. So much to do within a 15 minute walk. The place was cosy, clean today and well appointed
Wenley is a kind and friendly host. The room and the bed are big enough for a solo traveler. The place is close to the city but no direct public transport to the city.

Great location. Right near the art galleries and laneways of Melbourne. Cafes everywhere you look and public transport to everywhere right on your doorstep. The city is noisy, especially with construction going on, but keeping the windows closed keeps it pretty quiet in the flat. It's a good size. Nothing fancy but comfortable and very reasonably priced.

A very cute cottage set in a beautiful garden.  A seperate kitchen area that is fully stocked with everything you need.  Yolanda provides a great selection of breakfast options.  The bed is super comfy.  I always enjoy my stays here.
Nick was a great host and very welcoming . Apartment was nice and clean. Thanks for a lovely stay

Thanks for our second beautiful stay at Jacky Winter Gardens!
We felt so inspired surrounded by so much art, great literature and nature. The house is such a stunning piece of design. Every feature of the house from the skirting boards to the cupboard handles have been put together in such an artful way.
The perfect birthday getaway. Can’t wait to visit again.
This is great unit has all the amenities and is in a good location to explore both Melbourne and St Kilda. Close to transport and has secure parking.
We loved our stay at this apartment. It was such a great location handy to amenities and in a quiet street. The instructions for checking in were so clear, that even arriving in the rain was easy.

Kim's place is ideal for a solo traveller especially those who would like to have their own space. Kim was a great host, responded very quickly and was very accommodating to my needs/requests. Personally, I really appreciate the ensuite bathroom and the (working) desk in the guest room.  Kim also provided a TV and a fridge that can be a big plus for some people. Overall it was a great stay.  Thanks Kim !!!
Quiet, private surroundings. Clean and tidy. Bonus having a lockable garage, especially with a hire car. Thanks for a pleasant stay

Paul was great, sohelpful and always replied very promptly!
Apartment was lovely and spacious and perfect location to everything. Will be back
Stylish and spacious apartment in a great location - vicinity to Chapel St was great! Check in process was flexible and easy.

Vincent's apartment is located in a very convenient place if you're in Melbourne for a visit! With the Southern Cross station right in front of the building and several tram lines around, commuting was very easy for us.
The space was comfortable and had everything needed for a couple of nights. Rooms were tidy and warm.
