Good cleanliness and location, great reply speed from the host and very helpful. Bedsheets were 3 layers of separate sheets instead of a cover which we found uncomfortable and didn't stay put. Lift can take awhile

Jess and Dale were great hosts. We’re very flexible with our check in time given activities during the day that needed accommodation. An item or two missing from the original listing, but Jess was more than happy to help out. Place was very peaceful and a great location near some great wineries.

We had a great stay at The Jade House. It was beautiful, clean and very comfortable, we would stay again. Tan was very friendly and easy to communicate with, we highly recommend to anyone. Thank you so much.

We loved our stay in this rural setting, it was so beautiful despite the torrential downpours, gale-force wind, and the power outage we experienced. Natalie was very responsive and helpful. Thank you for the stay!

Shelly was so easy to contact the entirety of the stay at her property. She was so accomodating and lovely to deal with.
The house was clean, beautifully styled and the perfect get away Airbnb.
Thank you Shelly!

For us this was the perfect location - in the newer part of Footscray, but close to the train station with quick connections to the city, and also just a short walk to the older heart of cosmopolitan Footscray. Clean modern apartment. For information, please note that there are actually two sets of lifts - the main lifts from the entrance, and then a second set of lifts in the carpark. The rubbish chute is next to the lifts in the carpark, and not the main lifts. Also KeyPal is located at the North-Eastern corner of Southern-Cross Station - easy to find if you take the right exit from Southern Cross.
Perfect for our needs for a nearby wedding & close to Sydney St restaurants and shops. Highly recommended if you’re looking for something away from the hussle and bustle of traffic noise.
Over all  it is all good. But the price is a little bit of expensive  side.

Sarah' s apartment was perfect for my conference stay; 5 star in all respects, especially the tea selection! I also forgot my phone charger, and Sarah was kind enough to post it to me; thank you Sarah!
Great for a short stay business trip.  Flexible check-in. Walk to most of CBD or tram stops.

Dear Brigitte and John,
It was so great to stay at your cabin. The location was amazing, so picturesque, and it was such a serene getaway for us! The cabin was very tidy, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed for our comfortable stay. Our toddler loved the books, toys and mostly wanted to stay outdoors exploring your beautiful farm. You are great hosts, so warm and welcoming, and the homemade goodies were such a surprise treat with the personalized note. You were so approachable, and guided us with all that we needed. We had a great stay, and would love to be back! We would highly recommend this wonderful cabin! And the stop to the Farmers market on the way back was the perfect cherry on the cake to end a fun weekend getaway! Thank you for the recommendations!

One of the rooms faces directly into the sun rising which can get quite hot if you’re staying on a hot day. Had issues with hair on pillows. Also the walls are paper thin with the neighbours so had a bit of a scare thinking someone was in the apartment with me when I thought I was alone. (Can hear neighbours sneeze). Otherwise a great location to stay.

Phillip & Bree's apartment is perfect for a short stay in Melbourne. Right opposite Southern Cross station & within walking distance of dine very good restaurants. The keypal lockers are located just across the road from the building so easy access. The apartment is on the 36th floor & although facing the back of Spencer street, the views of the city buildings is quite mesmerising. Sparkling clean bathroom which is always important & a coffee pod machine with delicious pods. We enjoyed our night away & will definitely stay here again.

Great location. Ideal if you're on a budget and just need a shower and bed for the night. Room is comfortable and quiet. Peter is also very friendly host.
Showering in a tub to conserve water was a little tricky but I appreciate Peter's concern for the environment.

The place was very good but there was a few things we felt could be improved upon which was the person doing the meet and greet was ringing every 5 minutes to see where we were even though we said we would let him know when we were 15 minutes away. The couch and bed are dated and could do with replacement. The positives were that it was close to public transport and the space was functional for a 1br apartment. It had all facilities you would need. We enjoyed the view out over the Yarra river. The apartment was clean and tidy and even had wifi there. Close to coffee shops and cafes and restaraunts. Also close to tram stops to go to queen Victoria markets. And right across the road from the southern cross station. Public transport was a breeze. Would definitely stay here again

Kim place is the perfect place to stay in the city! Close to all the great shops and cafes you will not be disappointed with your stay at this beautiful penthouse apartment. Kim is very responsive and was able to answer any questions I had since it was my first time in Melbourne. Looking forward to booking this place again on my next holiday here!
was such a lovely stay! house was clean and the building was easily accessible. perfect for 8 people.

Honestly this place is like a soothing balm. Inspiration everywhere, everything is so beautiful and the house envelops you and snuggles you in as soon as you arrive. The house is super comfortable and has everything you need (I even baked!) with some added bonuses (that bath, I never wanted to leave it…) It’s within walking distance to Belgrave town & railway station, but you could just as easily keep yourself rested and entertained and never leave the house. Waking up to the sounds of birdsong and the babbling creek is just the best. Jeremy & Lorelei were so helpful, and the pack of information provided covers everything from how to use the amazing sound system in the house to where to get the best coffee. I will absolutely be back and have told everyone I know to go too - I loved this place so much. Thank you for creating this place, it’s magic ❤️

Michelle was a great host, extremely responsive and friendly. The loft was a unique, quirky space that we totally enjoyed. It was heaps of fun living the life of an inner city urbanite, even if it was just for a couple of days! Location is perfect. Highly recommend.

If you are looking for somewhere secluded, surrounded by greenery and fantastic views then this rustic cabin in the Yarra is the best place to stay! The cabin had everything we could need. Gabe was also very easy to communicate with and provided us all the relevant information prior to our stay.

Sheryl was an excellent host for our stay.  Always quick to respond and very helpful.  The place was great for our stay, as described and a prime spot across from the mall with lots for the kids to do in the surrounding area.  Would definitely stay again.

Super happy with this apartment! Great restaurants and shops along the street, easy flat 15min walk to free tram circle, or paid tram stop right outside the door, Woolworths next door and cute little nail salon right downstairs. plenty of room for 4 adults and 1 tween for a 3 night stay.

The house suited our needs perfectly and was just described. The beds were super comfortable, linen luxurious, kitchen very well provisioned, obvious focus on environmentally responsible items  and cleaning products.. all together a great stay with Carly being very helpful.
John was a great host- amazing communication, easy check in and quick replies. Place was great, had everything we needed.
Lovely apartment, within driving distance to shops and the beach. There is a bit of street noise but otherwise perfect for a short stay.

Probably one of the best airbnb's I've stayed at. Great location, easy to get around. Parking was very very good and very secure. One of the few airbnbs that feels like a real home, and the place felt well designed and nicely renovated. Seriously had everything we needed and easy check-in and check-out process. Very quiet at night, even over NYE. Would definitely stay there again in future. Only thing I'd say is the pillows were quite firm and high, but this a minor point.

We had an amazing time at Simon's beautiful house. We immediately felt at home, with an amazingly stocked kitchen and thoughtful gifts to help us settle in. The house is a great size and really comfortable. Location-wise it is easy walking distance to shops and great restaurants, as well as parks and walking trails along the river. I would definitely recommend Simon's place for a family looking for a beautiful place to stay in Melbourne.

This place was clean, well equipped with everything required. Apartment is in the perfect location for exploring Swan Street and the surrounding suburbs. Public transport right on the doorstep! I would stay here again!

75 Tristania Drive is a spacious and family friendly home. The location is private and the neighbourhood is nice. Grace is very friendly and great to message, should you ever need any help or advice. I would definitely recommend Grace and her home.

Virginia and Marks place was prefect for me and my daughter, everything we needed was there. The location was great we walked to the shops a few times. Great value too, I look forward to staying again.

There are 2 bathrooms , but only one with toilet roll. didn't realize it until it is to embarrassed.
Room facing west, with very nice sunset view. downside of that is the heat. Master bedroom (without air con) can be easily over 50 degree in a hot day. It was 35 in Melbourne while we stay). Aircon in sitting area is not powerful enough to cool it down after 2 hours. Highly recommend owner to install another one in Master bed.
you don't need a car, but we did hired one and get stuck in car park for almost 1 hour due to wrong key been given. Get questioned by security guards is also embarrassing.
overall, nice place to stay in a cooler days, if service can be improved will be even better.

Susan is such a great and accommodating host. She tries hard to make sure everything is taken care of, and is gracious and responsive. Beautiful apartment right in the heart of everything. The place is real clean, and the central AC is nice. There's nothing not to like!

Where do I start! Let's just wrap it up in one word... Exceptional! Vicki was very responsive & communicated in a timely manner. The cottage was a dream! Spotless, charming, warming & welcoming. Would be stay again? Absolutely!

Brand new feel at Shiya's place, and it was exactly as we saw on the Airbnb. Spacious, well-appointed and quiet. Comfy beds, super-efficient fridge, massive dining room table and lovely outdoor setting. Shiya was super quick with communication and we experienced no problems at all. Highly recommnded.

Location was great, Frank and Pam were very responsive, the apartment was clean and very well decorated. The only issue was noises from construction site next to the apartment but it wasn’t host issue or anything, but if you plan to stay during week days you will hear noises from 6:30 AM while there are construction works going on around the area ( our last day was Monday then we couldn’t sleep after 6:30 AM). Overall very happy with the apartment and our stay there.

Great place
with a nice garden and outdoor area
lots of space
would stay again

Great host, very responsive, helpful.
Apartment is spotless clean, breathtaking city views, convenient location, easy check in and check out. This is the second time we have stayed in one of their apartments, will definitely be coming back and highly recommended for anyone who is interested in staying in the Melbourne CBD.
Thank you Lee for hosting us again and we will be back :)

Wow!!!
What’s not to love about this place. A great, private and secure apartment complex which was one of the cleanest air BnB’s I’ve ever stayed in. We loved the ease of access to the city and the local coffee spots, supermarkets and amenities.
The bed and linen were more than comfortable abs my daughter and I enjoyed 11 amazing nights here.
Brigitte and John were incredibly friendly hosts. The cabin was comfortable, clean and I would highly recommend staying here.

We had a lovely stay at the cottage, the location is beautiful and the cottage itself was exactly as described. It came stocked with a great assortment of food, unfortunately we didn’t get to eat the fresh eggs - maybe next time! Would love to visit again and would highly recommend.

For one time i stayed in Allan s house and everything was perfect! It feels like home away from home!That s why in a few days i ll be back!The house is exactly as is being shown and the owners are the most sweet people!

Lyndall was fantastic, the cottage was amazing and the location was great. Lots of places to eat and easy access to the City. We loved having private access to come and go and Lyndall was great at communicating and helping us throughout our stay. 10/10 Would love to stay again.

Vikki contacted us with details of how to get access to key  -  worked well.  The nieghbourhood was very good, I enjoyed walking around it and admiring views out to the surrounding hills. Also an easy walk to shops.

John was a great host. He was always quick to respond to my requests. The apartment was flawless and the neighborhood was very eventful. We spent a week in Melbourne and we couldn't have aasked for a more perfect stay. Thank you John, it was a blast!

Katrinas place was lovely,
we enjoyed the location especially as we could walk into the city in 15 minutes. We enjoyed so many yummy restaurants in Fitzroy.
The location was very peaceful.
Beds were comfortable and kitchen was well equipped.
courtyard was lovely.

Nicky's place is a great 'home away from home'' for us.  Very close to amazing restaurants and two tram stops and the beach which we used quite frequently.  In saying that the Apartment was very quiet and couldn't hear the trams at all.  We used the trams to go to South Melbourne markets and got some great supplies to set us up for the week.  Also, Nicky was very responsive and had a few supplies ready for us eg milk, tea bags, fruit and some chocolate as we were very late arrival in to the Apartment on the first night.  We would highly recommend Nicky's place and are very much looking forward to booking another holiday in the near future.

Bordered by Smith Street, Gertrude Street, Brunswick Street & Johnston Str you have the choice of so many bars, restaurants, wine bars , iconic pubs and an amazing array of independent fashion both for sale & modeled on the street! Nikola is brilliant responsive host , we love Melbourne, we come often and if it’s available we will be staying here but longer next time . PS fabulous bathroom & parking.
Beautiful and unique. Cloud room is stunning and everything is clean and tidy. Right in the middle of the city so it is easy to get to everything. I’d definitely recommend staying here.

I arrived at the end of a long day. Easy key access. The private room and bathroom downstairs within Sean’s home was clean and supplied all necessary linen and furniture. Sean was friendly, easy to chat to and helpful w information for local eateries. I walked through Edinburgh Gardens to Brunswick street for a bite. Sean’s home is in a quiet area. The bed is comfortable. I checked out at 9am and had a pleasant stay. Thanks Sean

Martine is a wonderful host, highly recommended! Her place is comfortable, clean, and quiet, and she's very friendly and welcoming. We had great chats, she gave me many local recommendations, and even shared her delicious homemade bread. The apartment is well located, near Fitzroy and easy to get into CBD (12 min on the tram), but still private and quiet at night. This is a truly great place for the solo traveler.

We had a wonderful stay in Fitzroy. The apartment was in a great location, very clean and had everything you would need. We were also surprised how quiet is was for being in the heart of Fitzroy and in an apartment block. Will definitely be staying again. Cheers Max & Calypso :)

My now-husband and I stayed at the cottage the night before and night of our wedding, and the girls and I got ready there the morning of. We all had an absolute blast! It was so beautiful and peaceful and we really didn’t want to leave. Roslyn was so lovely, and I absolutely fell in love with Albert, the doggy. 10/10 recommend staying here if you are considering it

The apartment was in a good location for everything we needed to do, free parking was a plus for us, easy check in. The apartment itself is okay, clean, bed comfortable. The apartment is on the older side and a little easy to hear noise from outside but overall happy with the stay

Pro: Just as described and just like the photos they posted.
Con: The neighbour is a bit noisy.
First night there was no hot water for few hours but after informed they got it fix and running in less than 3hrs.

Samantha was terrific to deal with and usually ahead of the game with her communication .
Fabulous apartment compact but fabulous fittings and spotlessly clean .
I will definitely stay again....very good value

This is a hotel. The room did not match the pictures. Kitchen was much smaller and closed off. The pictures indicated there was a full floor to ceiling window. There was only one small 3 ish by 2 ft length window.

Nice and central location for many local wineries in the Yarra Valley. Recommend Morgans winery to drink, graze and relax with friends and family and only 10minute drive.  Accommodation is in a quiet location and short walk to the local shops and cafe.  Overall the house was comfortable and was all you needed for 4 people while visiting the country.
Host is very responsive even before i made the booking. Really happy with our stay, located in the middle of melb cbd. Close to grocery shops, shopping center, dessert place, cafe and restaurant.

Cabin is beautifully furnished, super clean & the location is stunning. Set on top of the hill amongst the cherry & fig orchards.
The kitchen is filled with delicious home made goodies that just made you feel so welcome.
Hosts are friendly and go above and beyond expectations to make your stay a memorable one. It’s definitely the place to choose in Wandin. Just gorgeous!!!
Amazing little place, which is a perfect base to explore Fitzroy and greater Melbourne. Such a warm and relaxing space to come home to after a long day on foot.

We absolutely loved our stay at Clara’s place. The loft had so much character, bed was super comfortable, wines on the top deck were great. Best thing about this place is the beautiful cafe/bar downstairs “Bertoncello” which we went to for coffees/cocktails/dinner for the two days we spent there. Right on the tram line to the city aswell, would highly recommend and hope to come back one day! Only thing is to be aware of is the no shower, although the bath was absolutely fine 🙂

Great place for wkend break. Serene and peaceful. Would be perfect if there are more bathroom. One for 5 bedrooms seems underplanned.
Decent value for money, but good for big groups. Views from living deck are green and serene, cannot really view the distant lake and the supposedly unblocked sunrise.

We stayed at the tiny house for our little elopement, which was everything we needed. It was quiet, private, and just right for the two of us. Everything was clean, and its size made us realize how incredible life can be with just the essentials. We connected with nature and enjoyed all its sounds, from crickets and birds to the rustling of some trees.
Katherine was also very responsive and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. She supplied us with some recommendations of things to do in the area, and even left us some treats. If we're ever in town again, I would definitely stay here again.

This was my first trip to Australia, and what a great way of making memories. Yolande is 100% a great host, with great communication skills, and a lovely attitude towards her guests. I felt at home away from home, walking to the cottage, sitting outside in the patio or just watching the birds in the garden. The cottage is beautiful, with plenty amenities and a fantastic kitchen. Yolande also made sure I had fresh food and toiletries to use during my stay - what a treat. She spoilt it for me forever. I love talking to her and getting to know her more and I would love to come back and stay longer. The best Airbnb experience I have ever had.
Marie was a wonderful host. She had great initiative dealing with problems out of our control before we knew they existed. Thankyou for taking such good care of us.

Great place to for a weekend in Melbourne. The house is very comfortable and beautifully decorated. Everything is high quality from the towels to the beds! We enjoyed the restaurants and cafes nearby and South Melbourne markets is a short walk away. Fiona was so helpful and responded very quickly. Would thoroughly recommend staying - we will be back!

Thanks so much Roslyn. Your cottage and property was the perfect place to get ready on the morning of our wedding and then have our first look and photos. Our families and vendors were in awe of the cottage and beautiful grounds also. Breakfast foods were supplied which was very kind. Thanks so much Roslyn it was perfect.

right near Preston markets, JT's place is fantastic. I stayed two weeks whilst studying a short course in Brunswick East. JT is friendly and welcoming. it was a great base for me. Safe and comfortable. so much fabulous food and wine bars close by.
Great accommodation and host. I always feel at home. I stay here everytime I have a business trip to Melbourne. Highly recommended.
if you are looking for a nice accommodation in Melbourne, you found it! beautiful house, verry nice hoste, I recommend!

Great location to stay in, very accessible for trams in all directions and train station in easy walking distance. Plenty of grocery and convenience stores nearby, but for the major food attractions and activities are within a short transport trip away. The train line is very close however we had zero issues with any noise. It is also right near the river, very easy to go for a walk by the water.
The apartment was great for its size and has plenty of utensils for cooking for yourself. Host was responsive and ground floor reception was lovely.
Awsome stay and very helpful instructions to access apartment. Very centralblocation with easy access to all Melbourne

My mum and I spent 7 nights at Alix abd Tak's beautiful accommodation over Easter this year and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The apartment had stunning views, was very comfortable, was in a fantastic location and matched the description and photos included in the listing. The gym, pool and sauna in the building were very handy and the apartment was walking distance from public transport and local attractions and restaurants. Alix and Taj were very communicative, friendly and responsive hosts and provided some great recommendations regarding things to see and places to eat during our time in Melbourne. The beds were also super comfortable and the water pressure in the showers was fantastic! We found that the kitchen was a little light-on in terms of utensils and cookware so we ended up purchasing some of our own and leaving it at the apartment, but overall we found the accommodation very comfortable, very much enjoyed our stay and enjoyed many nights on the couch watching Netflix!

Great little unit, close enough to the city via tram. Good selection of cafes and restaurants nearby. The location was very quiet at night, and the kitchen was well equipped for our needs. We will return, hopefully.
Tidy 3 bed beachfront unit located in walking distance to Luna Park and Acland St cafes. Host was responsive when needed. Would definitely stay again during the warmer months.

Overall the place is great for small family with young kids. There are some basic ingredients provided for cooking. Bed is too soft that made me a bit backache. No trash bags provided. There is no heater even we tried to turn on at 28-30c on AC, still quite cold in the room. Alex and team were nice and very responsive.

1 double bed, 1 twin bedded, 1 bunk bed and 1 double up the narrow stair at the attic. difficult for the aged to sleep upstair.
lots of antique, pictures in the house.
the BBQ pit is abit rusty, maybe good to change.
otherwise all is good, unique house.
very responsive. thanks

We had a delightful stay at the Cherry Boys. The breathtaking surroundings and charming decor made us feel right at home, and the fireplace added to the cozy atmosphere. We spotted wallabies and hot air balloons, which added to the magical experience. Brigitte and John, our hosts, were  warm and accommodating, making our stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommended for a relaxing and memorable getaway.

Although this listing is in the cbd it’s a decent trek to any tourist, shopping or dining locations. The place was left undesirably by cleaners from previous visitors. Lounge was broken. Also a lot of noise from the street outside. Comfy bed though and amenities were decent.

Kats place was in a fantastic location so close to the hub of great hotels, wine bars and shops in Fitzroy and a very easy walk into the CBD.
The apartment had everything we needed for our weekend stay and the use of the provided on street parking permit was so helpful.
Facilities were clean and well equipped. Bed was very comfortable.
Clear instructions from Kat re entering and exiting the property on our arrival made it stress free and the visitor information folder provided was relevant and comprehensive.
At all times felt safe and secure there. Would highly recommend.

Sam has amazing place to offer , his apartment was in the heart of the city which was easily accessible and it’s was smooth check in process . He has really pretty house with all basic amenities . The house is neat and clean above all sam is very active and despise within few mins. I would recommend everyone to please book this place for free team ride , easy access to CBD and walk-in for sea life and casino ( crown ) . The balcony has Melbourne’s best view to enjoy your even tea and morning coffee .

The host was very responsive and helpful from the start to the end. No parking at premise but can be arranged at a fee. The location is good. Close to everything. We enjoyed our time here & would recommend to everyone who needs a place to explore the city.
This place never disappoints! It's a gem in the city giving you great access to the Trams! Having been here before, this 2nd stay gives us good time to enjoy the city lights from the apartment!
Claire’s house was great! I loved the greenery out the front! It was a shame I only stayed for one night. ☺️

Madriena’s air bnb was so beautiful with amazing rooms and great location but quite noisy throughout the night/ early morning. Wish there was extra blankets and pillows in the cupboards but had a lot of other great amenities.

We loved staying at Yvonne’s place. She was so welcoming from the first message. When we arrived she had left a colouring book and toy for my two young girls on there beds and they were absolutely thrilled! What a way to make them feel comfortable and welcome, Thankyou Yvonne!
The furniture and linen were all beautiful quality, we would not hesitate to stay here again.

Very comfortable, light and airy. Accurately represented in photos, and host was super responsive and gave great instructions re secure parking and the like. Super convenient for me- close to all the places I was visiting. I will be back.

My organisation booked the home and apartments for a two night stay.  We were a group of 11 people and the space and bedrooms where just perfect for our needs.  The bedrooms are very comfortable and there are very adequate dining and kitchen facilities.  The property is centrally located and we walked to the main street on several occasions for dinner and lunch.  We would love to come back and stay again.  A wonderful experience.
Sam was a great host- very communicative and helpful -  and the apartment was clean and welcoming. Great location.
We loved our stay, great position in the CBD around the corner from Chinatown and lots of eateries. Highly recommend can't wait to come back.

We had trouble getting in contact with them to drop our bags off which was a paid extra. We found the water pressure and temp of the showers awful to use. The dinning room chairs are unsafe, you can see they’ve tried to add towels underneath to add support which isn’t working.
Great place to stay to explore Melbourne. Very central and can easily walk to most things. Would recommend.
I’m a return visitor and very happy with the location, facilities and cleanliness. Karen is a great host. I look forward to staying again next year.

Great host. Great place. Totally enjoy our stay. The location is super convenient and it has fantastic view looking towards East side of the city. There is a minor shortcoming, the common corridor is not very well ventilated, the air is a bit still with slight foul smell.

It was a great place to stay and a close distance to many attractions. It is also close to many supermarkets and restaurants for food. It was easy to get around with a stroller from the apartment to the places around it.
Something to take note; the apartment is on a very high floor, so if you're not fond of heights, you might want to reconsider the place.
We really enjoyed at stay at John’s. It was in a really good location, close to everything by foot or by tram. Has everything we needed and the snacks were a nice touch. Would recommend!

Perfect place for a short stay. Lee’s home is beautiful, so clean and well presented. The view from the 68th floor is incredible and the location is great. Lee was great at communicating and directions were easy to follow. Will definitely recommend and will be back for sure. 10/10
A great location, so easy to access public transport and close to local restaurants, this apartment was a great base for our Melbourne stay.

Accommodation was as described and shown. Place was conveniently located within free tram zone. Was travelling with a toddler, cot and high chair was provided. Ming was extremely responsive towards all queries raised. Had a wonderful stay overall:)
Few minor points to note:
1. Glasses provided. However there are no mugs available for hot drinks.
2. Limited kitchen tools for cooking, no peeler in the kitchen.
3. Need to be careful when you are showering. Do not flush the toilet or use the washing machine at the same time while showering. The water at the shower will turned very hot when use concurrently.
My parents stayed 5 nights here, although there were trains beside, but it’s still quiet, and the location is great, easy for you to find!
Great accommodation in the CBD. Easy walking to every thing we needed. Great views of the city at night. We will stay again with family.
Really enjoyed our stay at this cozy house, ample space for our family of 5. We love the location of the house, beautiful backyard and heating was perfect.

A wonderful 2-br penthouse in Richmond with a fabulous balcony for entertainment and an amazing view of the cityscape. Also appreciated all the cooking equipment. We really enjoyed Shane's place and would gladly stay again in the future!

We had a peaceful stay at Cosmo Carlton, really enjoyed the cafe's and restaurants nearby, super easy to get the tram service. Look forward to using this groovy little apartment again.
Many thanks Greg and Maureen.
We had a lovely stay. The house is private with an outlook on to the hills beyond. Perfect for a couple of days out of town to read and relax.

Beautiful place ,Pleasant stay .Lee was very proactive with all the instructions and provided us complimentary car park during our stay.
Instructions to the car park was a bit confusing but other than that everything was great.

Nice location located at the heart of Melbourne cbd. Place is clean, lots of things provided which is good and very handy. Secure parking spot. Sam is very responsive and helpful. Thanks for the great experience!

Lovely & comfortable 2 bedroom apartment. Stylish art deco decor. Great city views in a convenient, quiet location. Sparkling clean and very thoughtfully stocked. One of the best airbnb places we have stayed in. We loved it and would highly recommend.

Lovely character filled house set in stunning private location. Surrounded by amazing views and garden.
The kitchen was well equipped for family’s that made us feel right at home!
Great room layouts for large groups that were nice and clean.
The pool was amazing! Shame it was a little cold for us to use, but would love to visit again in the warmer months.
Michelle was so attentive as a host, she provided very detailed instructions and was super helpful. Quick to respond via email.

We had the best time at Shane's apartment! The balcony and views are both amazing. The apartment is spacious, tidy and just as it looks in the images.
The plants throughout are a beautiful touch and the location is nice and peaceful with coffee shops meters from the entrance while only a 10min drive to the city.
Shane was so easy to deal with and I would highly recommend staying in his apartment.
Very happy with the apartment. Very clean and nicely decorated. Ideal for our visit to Melbourne.    Thank you Paul and Dan.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Charming accommodation in a great location with really hospitable hosts. We look forward to returning on our next visit to Melbourne. Thanks Anthony and Cinthya.

Firstly, the apartment was wonderful with an amazing view, amazing facilities and very useful Woolworths downstairs :)
Then, all the support team was AMAZING, they always answered fast, try to find a solution, be understanding..
many many thanks for everything!

My family of 4 (2 children 11 & 13) enjoyed our stay at HV Hotel.
Katya was so helpful and answered all my questions and inquiries before we booked, after and during. Very polite and helpful.
The apartment is a no fuss property with all the little luxurious guests can hope for. I loved that all the amenities were full. No skimping out on soap, tea or laundry detergent. Having a box of tissues. All these things have been thought about and appreciated.
HV hotel is in an amazing location!!!
The only downside, for us who drove from SA, market days was a nightmare to find a park. Once we left in the morning and wanted to come back at lunch. However, After market hours was easy enough to find a park.
We would stay again. 🤍
The apartment is in the perfect location, access to good cafes and shops, lovely walks and great accessibility to the city. The apartment is exactly as the pictures show and beautifully cleaned.
Excellent location with easy access to public transportation, shopping mall, and restaurants. The flat we were staying in was clean, tidy and  fabulous with a fascinating view. Highly recommended
Beautiful accommodation and looks exactly like the photos. Stunning views. Ye was super helpful and quick to reply. Worth the stay!

Location was absolutely brilliant. We were going to game at Marvel stadium, so was fabulous. Place was clean, great shower and comfy beds.
Only problem was we needed to use sofa bed; which Peter knew, but there was no extra linen or pillows or blanket. We made do, but not ideal given 260 per night.
Location, serenity, cleanliness, fung shui. Everything was perfect! Definitely my go to whenever I visit melbourne.

It was a great place to stay and location. The front desk was friendly and we had no problems checking in or out. The room was clean and bed linen was crisp and fresh. We reported a bad smell in the communal corridor but that was attended to very quickly. Overall it was a great stay!
Fantastic place to stay, especially when attending the mcg, but with a tram stop right out the front easily accessible to the city too. Loved it
Beautiful apartment and so close to everything you would need even without a car. The bed + bed linen was also extremely comfortable and stood out the most. Will be staying again ☺️
Samuel's place was in an awesome location, super easy to get anywhere from. Would happily stay again.
Everything was great, easy check in & check out. Last min wanted parking,  & Lee was very responsive in assisting us to it. Defo will come back to stay again. Location was very convenient.

The bed was very uncomfortable as there were two single mattresses on top of a double sized bed frame. Also the air conditioning was not working and would not heat up the unit. Not the best experience. Could be so much better

Great place and ideal location, the access of the swimming pool, sauna and hot baths was amazing after a long trip.
Very responsive on check in and also following up on everything.
5 Stars
The bed wasn’t good to soft and uncomfortable.The bath mats are so slippery nearly fell several times.

Beautiful home with comfortable beds and spacious rooms! Very minimalistic - which me and mum loved. Also very close to the local mall thankfully.
Annie and Linh were very responsive, easy-going and very kind during our stay.

We had a fantastic  stay at Lisa’s place. She was very helpful when I had an issue making the booking, and she even accommodated a late check out. The place was clean and heated up nicely. Any of our questions were answered by the house manual on the counter.

Peter was lovely to deal with and was super quick with his responses. The apartment was clean and easy to get to. Peter's apartment had everything we needed to have a beautiful weekend away in Melbourne with 2 teenage girls.

This is the second time that I have been able to stay in Maja's home and I love it here.  The atmosphere is warm and welcoming and feels like home, unlike a hotel room.  The area is leafy green, quiet and safe with a mix of lovely and friendly neighbours.  Walking distance to Clifton Hill and North Fitzroy shopping strips as well as Smith and Brunswick Streets for an eclectic mix of stores and restaurants.  Tram close by for a quick trip in to the CBD, museums and the art centre.  Perfect for me.  Thank you Maja.

From the moment we stepped into Liisa’s apartment, we knew our stay was going to be spectacular. Everything was exceptionally cleaned and looked exactly like the photos. We stayed at Liisa’s place for about 6 weeks and had everything we needed and more.
Location was perfect. Super close to shops and cafes and also had a peaceful feel among the tree lined streets. As a host, Liisa was extremely communicative and went well above and beyond to answer any questions we had. I can’t recommend this place enough. I’d give it 100 stars if I could. Thanks again, Liisa!

Such a stylish inner urban pad perfect for mum and daughter visiting St Kilda. Great location for tram rides to the city. Very spacious and comfortable - the front room is fantastic with beautiful light and street vista to take in. Working from home while away from home was made all that better because of it. Perhaps the only limitation is a small bathroom given the rest of the residence is roomy and well-appointed, but this would not stop us from returning. Vincent was a great host too - super attentive and friendly. Thank you.

We had a lovely time staying in Karen's guest cabin. The supplies provided for breakfast were excellent including fresh strawberries from the garden. We loved sitting on the deck, watching the kangaroos and kookaburras and listening to the birds. Karen was very welcoming and helpful - giving us lots of tips about the best places to eat in the area. We would love to stay again. Thanks Karen!
The hotel is good right in the city. One of the problem was it doesn’t mention which floor with view and which is not when you book it. You need to understand it from price.

Couldn’t recommend staying with Anastasia enough, beautiful space, wonderfully decorated, fairly central and host was amazingly thorough with instructions and super responsive.
thanks again for having me, Anastasia!

I arrived in the morning and tried to put my luggage there. The lady at the reception was really friendly and she checked me in when she found out the room was available. The room is exactly the same as the picture on the website. It was a wonderful experience with Canvas!

I enjoyed my stay and it was helpful that it was a hotel because I wanted to store my luggage after I checked out because my flight was in the evening and they were able to hold it for me. Staff were responsive to questions on the app.
Such a beautiful, cozy place that you immediately right at home in. Walking distance to lots of shop and whatnot. Fantastic value for money!

Yolande's peaceful cottage was a home away from home. from the welcoming Persian " grumpy" cat to the fragrant garden , fully equipped but separate kitchen, swarming bees, and incredibly comfy bed it was all a lovely experience . yolande and her neighbors were responsive and helpful all the time.

Second time staying at Sarah's! It's a fabulous place, great location, has everything you need for a city getaway. Sarah is lovely and always responds to messages very promptly. Would absolutely recommend to anyone and I'm sure we'll be back again. :)
Thank you Dora for a lovely stay. It was such a beautiful space with so much greenery!!!

This apartment was absolutely fabulous for my mam, myself, my partner and our toddler. Gorgeous bedrooms and a fantastic outdoor area with a beautiful view. Ideal for sitting out and eating :) we really enjoyed our time here, great restaurants and cafes in walking distance and also close to transport. Hosts were very friendly and responsive, easy check in and out. Would highly recommend. Thank you

Amazing Location! Very helpful via dms and the carpark was wide enough for our car and secure !
Definitely will stay here again and recommend to friends and family
Thank you for making our stay amazing
Thanks Lianne and Paul for a great stay at your little hideaway in nature!! Highly recommended to future guests ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Julieanne's home was the perfect space for our getaway - on a peaceful street, with an easy walk to cafes, shops and restaurants. The home is very spacious and beautifully decorated - each area of her home is welcoming. We felt right at home! We enjoyed our stay and would love to visit again.
The apartment is well located for access to trams and Albert Park. Walkable to St Kilda and beaches. The apartment complex was great on hot days!

Lovely stay at Manik’s ,everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Manik was helpful and a great cook - she treated us a couple of times !
Highly recommend a stay here .
We had a car so travel wasn’t a problem, but we also went into city by train too to see “Moulin Rouge” - fantastic- we were lucky to get tickets at short notice - trains easy from Clayton station.
A great stay in a super convenient location with a beautiful view. I'd be very happy to stay here again!

We had a great stay at Vincent's apartment. It's a nice and cozy apartment and we had no trouble fitting 6 people in.
The location was great with close proximity to great cafes and restaurants around Melbourne.
Would stay here again.
Thanks!

The unit is in a quiet location 10 min drive from the CBD.
The unit was clean and tidy with all the comfort to feel like at home.
.
Cosy little cottage and had wild life come to great us at the door. Close to restaurants and activities.

The accommodation is conveniently located right in front of a tram stop serviced by a free tram, making transportation extremely convenient. We were able to enjoy a happy and relaxing trip in this truly modernly designed lodging. If you are traveling in Melbourne, I highly recommend this perfect accommodation.
Perfect location with everything you need, or a tram to it, within walking distance, and the flat contained everything you might need for your stay - thanks Sarah!
This apartment was perfect for me and 3 friends for a  weekend getaway in Melbourne. Everything you need is right on your door step.

Fiona's terrace home made our stay in Melbourne and provided a great alternative to a luxury hotel experience. We loved the decor and design throughout the home and would recommend this property to anyone wishing to have more of an authentic stay from a local's perspective. This hideaway on the South bank truly delivered a sense of place and a quintessential taste of Aussie hospitality.
